jobs.title: Project Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Project Operations Coordinator plays a crucial role in ensuring the smooth and efficient execution of project\-related sales orders and logistics. This position is responsible for managing the entire sales order lifecycle, from entry and revision in the ERP system to shipment coordination, and return material authorization (RMA) processing. The Project Operations Coordinator collaborates closely with internal teams, including Sales, Planning, Engineering, Projects, Controls, and Warehouse, as well as external customers and logistics providers, to ensure timely delivery and customer satisfaction. This role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and excellent communication abilities.

  

  

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  

  

Sales Order Management:


Accurately enter sales orders into the ERP system and submit them for approval.


Manage and process sales order revisions and updates as needed.


Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date sales order data within the ERP system.

  

  

Shipping and Logistics Coordination:


Oversee and track past due shipments, proactively addressing any potential delays.


Create shipping documents and manage the shipping process.


Contact customers to inform them of parts readiness for pickup or shipment.


Generate reports for new shipments to track progress and identify potential issues.


Coordinate crating requests with external vendors.


Verify weights and dimensions with the warehouse team to ensure accurate packing lists and commercial invoices.


Edit and finalize packing lists and commercial invoices.

  

  

Compliance and Documentation:


Conduct End\-User Certificate (EUC) checks for internal company orders to ensure compliance with export regulations.

  

  

Customer and Vendor Communication:


Serve as a primary point of contact for customers and logistics companies, providing timely updates and resolving any inquiries or issues.

  

  

Return Material Authorization (RMA) Processing:


Manage the RMA process, including receiving, processing, and tracking returned materials.

  

  

Other Duties:


Perform other related tasks as assigned from time to time by the manager and senior staff.

  

  

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE


A bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, International Trade, or a related field is required. Alternatively, relevant work experience in a related field may be considered in lieu of a degree. All candidates must possess a high school diploma or equivalent.


2\-3 years of experience in logistics, operations, manufacturing or a related field.


Relevant internship experience may be considered in lieu of full\-time work experience.

  

  

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES


Strong organizational and time\-management skills: Ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and meet deadlines.


Excellent communication skills (written and verbal): Ability to communicate effectively with internal teams, customers, and vendors.


Attention to detail and accuracy: Ability to ensure data accuracy and prevent errors in order processing and documentation.


Proficiency in Excel for reporting and data analysis.


Problem\-solving and analytical skills: Ability to identify and resolve issues related to orders, shipments, and customer inquiries.


Customer service orientation: Ability to provide excellent customer service and build positive relationships.

UCLA Health runs and operates over 300 outpatient clinics located in Southern California with over 3,000,000 outpatient encounters annually. The Patient Access Organization (PAO) serves as the centralized access team for UCLA Health’s ambulatory enterprise, ensuring timely, convenient, and equitable access to care for patients and the communities we serve. Our teams oversee high\-volume centralized scheduling and call center operations, new patient referral intake and navigation, enterprise template and capacity management, workforce training and quality oversight, and scheduling pathways and technology optimization, including decision tree development and digital innovations. We operate at the intersection of operations, technology, and clinical partnership to align supply and demand, streamline workflows, and continuously improve how patients enter and engage with UCLA Health.



The Executive Assistant/Special Projects Coordinator for the PAO provides professional analytical support, project coordination and management, as well as specialized and general administrative support. The incumbent is responsible for managing the Senior Director's calendar, correspondence, administrative tasks and various projects as assigned. This role will also support other leadership team members across the PAO.

**POSITION SUMMARY**  

This position supports the work of the Y, a leading nonprofit committed to strengthening community through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility. Promotes and supports the potential of all youth in programs and facilitates peer\-to\-peer connections as part of the overall program experience. Provides direction for the teens in programs, and lead classes focused on skills based learning. Provides a quality experience to teens that focuses on building achievement and belonging in teens. The Teen Coordinator is responsible for carrying out curriculum of the YMCA Teen Department to ensure student/participant involvement and academic achievement through utilization of technology and team building activities. This person will also create a positive environment for participants in an at\-risk area of the community.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Develop robust recruitment strategy to enlist new student participants into the program.
* Plan and coordinate Teen Night monthly schedule and learning plan.
* Write and carry out day to day curriculum and lesson plans relating to teaching media skills, cooking, gardening, arts and crafts, college exploration, career readiness, functional skills, and more.
* Directly provide instruction for youth in the above lesson plan subject areas using creative hands\-on project\-based approaches.
* Effectively collaborate with partners and clients from city and state government, public schools, community\-based organizations, community groups and private sectors.

* Track the progress of youth in the program and individualize the instruction as needed to ensure that all youth gain new skills and are successful.

jobs.description:
**Job ID** 20730 **Location** Beverly Hills, California, United States **Job Category** Academic / Research **Date posted** 09/30/2026

**Job Description**
-------------------


This role follows a hybrid work schedule with an expected on\-site presence of 4 days per week. Applicants must be able to commute to our Los Angeles work location and, if hired, must reside within a commutable distance.


The Clinical Research Coordinator III works independently providing study coordination including screening of potential patients for protocol eligibility, presenting non\-medical trial concepts and details, and participating in the informed consent process. Responsible for oversight of all studies with the group and the assignment of studies to clinical research personnel within the group, and supervision of research staff. Plans and coordinates strategies for increasing patient enrollment, improving efficiency, training of personnel, and identifying new research opportunities. jobs.title: Experiential Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Hadrian \- Manufacturing the Future**
=======================================


Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full\-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission\-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

  

Following our $1\.37B Series D at a $7\.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory\-as\-a\-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

  

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

  

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

**The Role**
------------


Hadrian is hiring an Experiential Marketing Manager to own every moment where someone meets Hadrian in person. This is the single owner of our events portfolio, from a twelve\-person dinner in a private room to a flagship launch built around a working factory floor.


This role exists because physical experience is our highest\-conviction channel. The people we most want to reach, the engineers building autonomous systems and the machinists and technicians who run them, do not decide where to spend the next five years of their career because of an ad. They decide after they walk a floor, put their hands on a part, and talk to the people doing the work. Your job is to engineer that encounter and then run it at scale across multiple cities.


You will inherit a portfolio that is already in motion and under\-resourced, and you will own it end to end: strategy, calendar, budget, vendors, production, staffing, and the follow\-through that turns a good night into a hire or a customer conversation. This is a builder role with real budget and real autonomy, not a coordinator role executing someone else’s brief.

**Why Now**
-----------


We are scaling our manufacturing footprint across multiple sites and hiring aggressively into the Bay Area and beyond, and our events calendar is about to go from occasional to continuous. jobs.title: Territory Sales Representative (Los Angeles)
jobs.description:
**Staples is business to business.** You're what binds us together.

  

Our world\-class sales and sales support teams work directly with businesses of all sizes to offer products and services to meet our customers’ unique needs. We are committed to understanding our customers and use best\-in\-class sales tools and technology to find the best solutions. We’re constantly discovering new ways to reach our goals, taking time to develop our skills and investing in our career growth, so we can enjoy lucrative opportunities and grow our careers both within and beyond sales.


Hunts within defined territory to prospect and win net new small to medium business customers. B2Bs are also responsible to ramp and onboard net new won accounts to further expanding our customer base. It is a high velocity sales position that leverages a prioritized call list to drive prospect engagement remotely by phone, video, face to face, and utilizing digital tools.

 **Location:** This is a remote position with a regional focus. This position supports customers in *Northwest Los Angeles, CA*. While the role primarily supports working from home, the individual performing this role would live within or adjacent to this region.

 **What you’ll be doing:**

  

* Exhibit effective appointment setting skills and set the required number of appointments each week with the correct decision makers.
* Effective Selling Skills
* Utilizing professional selling skills
* Discover prospects incremental and programmatic needs
* Effectively communicates Staples value propositions, capabilities, products and assortments including all categories
* Capable of overcoming objections and closing the sale.
* Utilize prescribed selling tools to prioritize activities and drive efficiency, as well as to document customer engagement and information (ex: Priority List, Tenfold, SFDC).
* Internal Partnerships: Effectively work with customer support/set up teams and category specialists to progress deals forward to closed won
* Implements and ramps wins driving compliance to new account/program
* Expertise of prospect industry buying process’ and ability to support product selection and standardization
* Create sticky accounts which will continue to purchase from Staples
* Integrates feedback from prospects into their sales approach
* New customer assortment and pricing
* Internal Teaming: Individual will need to communicate and work closely with Category Specialists, and Support teams
* Customer Communications: Individual is responsible to communicate with prospects daily in person and face to face in a professional manner

 **What you bring to the table:**

  

* Strong drive and a desire to win
* Strong aversion to complacency
* Proven ability to view rejection as a learning opportunity and double down on next best actions
* Experience and proven track record of business development
* Strong ability to develop and deliver presentations virtually and in person
* Consultative selling, solutions selling, insight selling, negotiation and advanced client management skills
* Ability to work with product category sales team members
* Strong business, financial, operations and technology acumen
* Ability to analyze business and industry trends to create tailored solutions for prospects based upon Staples value proposition
* Ability to function independently with minimal daily supervision
* Ability and motivation to find, develop, and close sales
* Demonstrated work ethic, self\-disciplined
* Ability to succeed in a competitive selling or goal\-oriented environment
* Ability to be coached and to incorporate feedback
* Professional appearance and demeanor
* Strong organization and time management skills

 **What’s needed\- Basic Qualifications:**

  

* 1\-3 years of successful sales experience or success as a Staples B2B Sales Associate
* 3\+ years experience in PowerPoint, Excel, and Outlook

 **What’s needed\- Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree
* Knowledge of Customer Relationship Management tool (CRM)
* Industry knowledge, a plus

 **We Offer:**

  

* Inclusive culture with associate\-led Business Resource Groups
* Flexible PTO (22 days) and Holiday Schedule
* Online and Retail Discounts, Company Match 401(k), Physical and Mental Health Wellness programs, and more!

The specific base pay may be influenced by a variety of factors to include the candidate's experience, skill set, education, geography, business considerations, and internal equity. In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for bonuses, or other forms of variable compensation.*

jobs.title: Server / Social Media Specialist / Live Streamer
jobs.description:
Campus Billiards \& Sports Bar. is hiring a Server / Social Media Specialist for weekends. This is one cohesive role with two major responsibilities: serving the room and owning our social media presence.

You will be on the floor serving, selling shots, and taking care of guests on busy Friday and Saturday nights. You are also the person fully in charge of all Campus social content—filming, appearing on camera, talking about sports, acting or modeling for TikToks, live\-streaming, editing, and posting during every single shift.

This is not a position where you just take a few phone videos if you happen to find the time. You are the content person for our nightlife footprint. If you only want to serve, please do not apply. If you only want to film behind the scenes and never want to be featured on camera yourself, this is not the role for which you should apply.

What You Will Do

Serving \& Floor Support

* Serve shots, beer, cocktails, and food.
* Help drive shot sales and specialty drink promotions when the room is packed.
* Learn our craft beer selection and operate the POS system efficiently.
* Work collaboratively as an active part of the floor team.

Social Media \& Live Streaming

* Film and post content talking about the sports games and match\-ups of the day.
* Appear as the main on\-camera talent—talking, acting, and modeling for TikTok and Instagram Reels.
* Go live on social platforms during peak hours to showcase the room, crowd, and energy.
* Film the crowd, the screens, the drinks, and the overall vibe of the bar.
* Edit and finalize clips using CapCut and Canva before the end of your shift.
* Help grow our digital following to bring more foot traffic through the door.

Required Skills \& On\-Camera Comfort

You must already be highly proficient and comfortable with:

* TikTok and Instagram (creating, editing, and publishing Reels/videos).
* CapCut and Canva.
* Being the center of attention on camera (talking\-head videos, skits, and promotional modeling).

*Note: Content creation is a core part of your mandatory shift duties, not extra work to do after you clock out.*

Required Schedule (No Exceptions)

You must be able to work both of the following shifts every single week:

* Friday: 9:00 PM – 2:00 AM
* Saturday: 9:00 PM – 2:00 AM

Because we operate with a small, tightly knit crew, we are unable to accommodate time\-off requests for upcoming concerts, weddings, parties, or trips. Please do not apply if you have existing schedule conflicts on these nights. Total reliability and dependability are strict conditions of employment.

Requirements

* Must be 21 years of age or older.
* Outgoing, reliable, and comfortable navigating a high\-volume sports bar floor.
* Extremely comfortable speaking, acting, and modeling on camera.
* Proven ability to create, edit, and finish digital content efficiently during a fast\-paced shift.
* Reliable transportation and a strict commitment to arriving on time.
* Physical ability to walk, stand, and move quickly for the entire duration of the shift.
* Must pass a pre\-employment drug screen.
* Willingness to learn our craft beer menu.
* *Prior bar or restaurant experience is a plus, but dynamic on\-camera personality and the ability to consistently deliver completed content matter most.*

Pay \& Perks

* $17\.00/hour plus a shared tip pool.
* Growth Opportunities: This is an excellent job for someone currently studying social media marketing who wants hands\-on industry experience. For the right dependable worker, we offer opportunities over time to cross\-train behind the bar and learn the trade of bartending.

How to Apply

Apply directly on Indeed and include links to your public Instagram and TikTok profiles. We review social media portfolios first to evaluate on\-camera comfort and editing style.

Pay: From $17\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Employee discount

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
We are a pet food company seeking an organized, detail\-oriented coordinator to manage customer orders, freight, shipping documentation, invoicing, and state product registrations. This role works with production partners, carriers, customers, and regulatory agencies to keep orders and shipments moving accurately and on schedule.

**Responsibilities**

* Enter dry, canned, and raw food orders; create sales orders and purchase orders; update production worksheets and sales records; and send order confirmations.
* Compile monthly production orders and supporting purchase orders.
* Request and review freight quotes, coordinate pickups, prepare bills of lading and pallet tags, and track freight charges.
* Prepare and check commercial invoices, packing slips, certificates of origin, lot code and best\-by information, and other documents for international shipments.
* Coordinate documentation for shipments involving Canada, South Korea, and Japan, including applicable USFWS and APHIS processes.
* Maintain state licenses and product registrations, track renewal requirements, and submit tonnage reports where required.
* Post purchase orders and sales orders, process invoices, and coordinate credits for damages or shipping errors.
* Document pallet temperatures and loading details for applicable shipments.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in sales operations, order processing, logistics, regulatory administration, or a related role.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when checking shipping documents and meeting filing deadlines.
* Proficiency with Excel and the ability to work across multiple recordkeeping

This position is designed as a sales development role and will rotate through a number of different territories. This position may be asked to assist the Merchandising Department during particularly heavy merchandising periods.**Job Description:**

**Job Responsibilities:**


Calls on accounts and covers daily routes by creating an established and efficient routing pattern.

* Prepares and delivers professional sales presentations to customers by balancing the company’s priorities and customer’s needs to include selling display ideas, new products, cold box, shelf, back bar placements and resets, drink and wine lists, and promotions.
* Maintains product levels in accounts by taking inventory and restocking shelves (where legal).
* Ensures maximum brand visibility within accounts by using effective and current point of sale materials when appropriate.
* Obtains payments for company by collecting and delivering checks or other remittance from accounts where legally permissible.
* Educates account staff by conducting educational staff training seminars on brands.
* Services accounts by delivering products to customers in extenuating circumstances, handling customer issues and complaints and referring these issues as appropriate to management.


Strategizes/preplans on how best to achieve sales and merchandising objectives by understanding company pricing and product programming information on a monthly basis and maintaining accurate historical account purchase information.

* Ensures national account compliance where applicable by accurately completing all necessary surveys.
* Understands the account’s buying patterns by reviewing the company pricing and product programming information on a monthly basis and maintains accurate historical account purchase information.
* Attains standards of performance goals by achieving the distribution, volume and activity goals of supplier brands as set by management.
* Manages customer account receivables by timely processing of credits and returns and communicating with accounts on aged receivables.
* Remains informed of company/supplier activities and updates by attending and actively participating in weekly sales meetings.


Other duties, as assigned by the jobholder’s supervisor, may also be required.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related field and/or equivalent training and work experience
* Minimum of 2 years’ experience in sales
* Basic PC skills using MS Office and other various computer programs including presentation software
* Must be a results\-oriented professional with verbal/written communication skills using diplomacy and discretion as well as customer service skills
* Ability to multi\-task, work independently and/or within a team, pay attention to detail and meet deadlines
* Analytic and Reporting skills
* Utilize sound judgement and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to work in fast\-paced, high\-volume, team environment
* Have a valid driver’s license

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Ability to hold a Solicitor’s Permit
* Understanding of wine and spirits

**Physical Requirements:**

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to, stand, sit; talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to reach overhead, squat and bend
* Carrying and lifting 45\-65 pounds

* Accountable for results which impact the department.
* Selects best option from a set of defined procedures/ solutions using common sense and experience of similar situations.

jobs.title: Cardiovascular Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Description**


The Cardiovascular Sales Representative (CSR) is responsible for achieving or exceeding sales goals within an assigned geography while operating in a compliant and ethical manner. This role develops and executes territory strategies, identifies customer needs, and drives results. Using strong analytical skills, the CSR evaluates regional market data to build and implement strategic territory business plans, foster lasting professional relationships, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional partners. The ideal candidate has strong business acumen, is resourceful, self\-motivated, results\-oriented, and collaborative.

**Responsibilities**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key customers and accounts with the goal of maximizing sales.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with targeted physicians to maximize new business opportunities.
* Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross\-functional discipline is critical. Cross\-functional partners may consist of FRMs, TLLs, Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers.
* Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources such as next best action, to determine strategies and tactics for business decision\-making.
* Demonstrate account\-based selling skills (including group presentations, etc.).
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company’s brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in training and development programs.
* Comply with all legal, regulatory and compliance policies and demonstrate a high level of integrity and professionalism at all times.
* Additional duties as required.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Business or a related field required.
* 3\+ years of pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical sales experience.
* 2\+ years of cardiovascular/cardiometabolic strongly preferred.
* Experience in highly managed, payor\-controlled markets is strongly preferred.
* Consistent track record of documented top\-tier sales accomplishments.
* Experience calling on assigned targets in the designated territory geography highly desired.
* Experience launching products in competitive marketplace.
* Ability to learn complex scientific information, apply technical proficiency and effectively communicate.
* Must be self\-motivated and able to work with a high level of autonomy and independence.
* Strong technical \& analytical skills including proficiency with CRM, AI tools and Microsoft Office Suite.
* A valid driver’s license and ability to travel as needed, which may include overnight and/or weekend travel.

  

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $120,000 to $130,000\. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.

**Why Syneos Health?** Our ability to collaborate and problem\-solve makes a difference in patients’ lives daily. By joining one of our account management teams, you will partner with industry experts and be empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy needed to successfully navigate the complex market access landscape. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.


Work Here Matters Everywhere \| How are you inspired to change lives?

* Drive the sale of service programs, to meet/exceed sales and margin goals.
* Use existing customer base and new lead information to develop and increase the sales of service offerings.

* Facilitate proper quoting, positioning, promoting and selling of services to ensure high close rates.
* Ensure accurate forecasting, account planning, and reports are maintained and submitted on a weekly, monthly and quarterly basis.

jobs.description:
**Field Sales Representative**
------------------------------

 **Amplity has partnered with one of our leading pharmaceutical clients for an exciting direct hire placement opportunity.**

### **Position Summary**


The Field Sales Representative is responsible for driving sales performance and achieving business objectives within an assigned territory by effectively promoting and educating healthcare professionals on approved products. This role requires the ability to build trusted relationships with physicians, healthcare providers, pharmacies, clinics, hospitals, and other key customer accounts through compliant, customer\-focused interactions.


The representative utilizes strategic territory planning, clinical knowledge, and consultative selling skills to deliver impactful product presentations, identify customer needs, and implement targeted business plans that contribute to market share growth. Success in this role requires strong analytical capabilities, sound business acumen, effective communication skills, and a commitment to compliance with all company policies and industry regulations.


This position requires up to 50% travel, including occasional overnight travel and periodic weekend participation in patient support programs or company\-sponsored events.


The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is **$80,000 to $95,000**. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, education, geographic location, and overall qualifications.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Territory Management and Sales Execution (60%)**

* Achieve and exceed sales goals and key performance metrics within the assigned territory through effective business planning and execution.
* Develop and maintain strategic territory plans that maximize customer engagement and business opportunities.
* Deliver balanced, accurate, and compliant product presentations using approved promotional materials.
* Establish and maintain productive relationships with healthcare providers and key stakeholders.
* Execute targeted call plans and maintain appropriate call frequency based on customer segmentation and business objectives.
* Identify opportunities to expand product utilization while addressing customer needs and clinical considerations.
* Manage and document product sample distribution in compliance with Company policy and Prescription Drug Marketing Act (PDMA) requirements.
* Maintain accurate customer records, territory information, and sales activity documentation.
* Utilize all approved sales and marketing resources to communicate product value and support customer decision\-making.

### **Product Expertise and Customer Engagement (20%)**

* Develop and maintain comprehensive knowledge of assigned therapeutic areas, disease states, and product indications.
* Apply the Company's sales methodology, including DiSC communication principles, to effectively engage diverse customer personalities and practice settings.
* Conduct pre\-call planning and post\-call analysis to optimize customer interactions and improve outcomes.
* Analyze territory performance data, account insights, and sales reports to identify trends and opportunities.
* Leverage approved business development resources and promotional budgets to maximize territory performance.

### **Administrative and Compliance Responsibilities (20%)**

* Complete expense reports, call reporting, and other administrative requirements accurately and on time.
* Document customer interactions and sales activities promptly within the Veeva CRM system.
* Monitor and respond to company communications and email correspondence daily.
* Ensure proper care, maintenance, and security of company\-issued equipment, including laptops, tablets, mobile devices, and fleet vehicles.
* Maintain compliance with all company policies, regulatory requirements, and industry standards.

**Additional Responsibilities**
-------------------------------

* Adhere to all corporate compliance policies, procedures, and ethical standards.
* Participate in sales meetings, training programs, conference calls, and professional development activities.
* Support patient\-focused programs and initiatives as needed.
* Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned.
* Demonstrate professionalism, accountability, and commitment to organizational values.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

### **Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, Healthcare, or a related required.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered.

### **Experience**

* Pharmaceutical sales experience.
* Specialty pharmacy experience.
* Experience supporting limited distribution products.
* Experience calling on specialty physicians and healthcare providers.

* Territory and business planning
* Customer relationship management
* Account management
* Influencing and negotiation skills
* Sales presentation and communication skills
* Business acumen and market analysis
* Direct selling experience

* CRM systems, preferably Veeva or Salesforce
* Microsoft Office Suite
* Data analysis and reporting tools
* Digital selling and virtual engagement platforms

### **Professional Competencies**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Self\-motivation and initiative
* Organizational and time management skills
* Problem\-solving and critical\-thinking abilities

jobs.description:
**Associate Sales Representative**
==================================

### **Calling early career candidates with entry level experience from the following industries:**
***Medical Device Sales \| Healthcare Sales \| B2B Sales \| Pharmaceutical Sales***

**Location:** Los Angeles, CA

**Launch Your Career in Medical Device Sales**
----------------------------------------------


Rep\-Lite is partnering with an innovative healthcare technology leader seeking ambitious, early\-career sales professionals who are ready to build a successful career in medical device sales.


This is an outstanding opportunity for individuals with **1–2 years of pharmaceutical sales, medical device sales, B2B outside sales, healthcare sales, business development, or account management experience** who are looking for structured training, mentorship, and a clear path into a high\-growth medical sales career.


If you're competitive, coachable, relationship\-driven, and motivated by making an impact on patient care, we'd love to hear from you.

**About the Opportunity**
-------------------------


As an Associate Sales Representative, you'll partner with experienced Territory Managers to expand the adoption of innovative healthcare technologies that improve patient outcomes. You'll gain hands\-on experience developing physician relationships, supporting clinical customers, and growing business across your assigned territory while building the foundation for a long\-term career in medical device sales.


This position is designed for **high\-potential professionals with grit, curiosity, resilience, and a desire to grow into a Territory Manager.**

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Partner with senior sales professionals to grow business throughout your territory
* Develop relationships with physicians, primary care providers, healthcare administrators, office managers, nurses, and clinical staff
* Support and **target healthcare accounts** while identifying opportunities to expand business
* Educate healthcare providers on innovative diagnostic technologies and clinical solutions
* Increase product awareness, utilization, and customer engagement
* Execute territory business plans and identify new growth opportunities
* Learn healthcare economics, reimbursement, and clinical workflows within physician offices and health systems
* Deliver exceptional customer service while becoming a trusted resource for customers
* Maintain accurate territory activity and sales reporting
* Consistently work toward achieving and exceeding sales goals

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required
* **1–2 years of experience in one or more of the following:**
	+ Pharmaceutical Sales
	+ Medical Device Sales
	+ B2B Outside Sales
	+ Healthcare Sales
	+ Business Development
	+ Account Executive
	+ Account Management
	+ Clinical Sales
	+ Inside Sales with outside customer interaction
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Strong relationship\-building abilities
* Valid driver's license with the ability to travel throughout the assigned territory, with 25\-50% travel \- including 1\-2 overnights per week

**The Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------


We're looking for professionals who are:

* Competitive and results\-oriented
* Coachable and eager to learn
* Self\-motivated with a strong work ethic
* Curious, resilient, and adaptable
* Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a team
* Passionate about improving patient outcomes
* Excited to build long\-term relationships with healthcare professionals
* Looking for long\-term career advancement within medical device sales


These qualities closely align with what our client values in future sales leaders.

**What You'll Gain**
--------------------


This role offers an exceptional opportunity to accelerate your medical sales career through:

* Industry\-leading sales training
* One\-on\-one mentorship from experienced Territory Managers
* Hands\-on field selling experience
* Exposure to physicians, healthcare systems, and clinical environments
* Career path into a full Territory Manager role
* Ongoing professional development
* Experience selling innovative healthcare technology that improves patient care

**Compensation \& Benefits**
----------------------------

* Competitive base salary of $90,000
* Performance\-based quarterly commission opportunity
* Mileage reimbursement provided
* T\&E reimbursement provided
* Comprehensive health benefits
* Paid training
* Career development opportunities
* The opportunity to break into the exciting world of medical device sales and grow your career

**Why You'll Love This Opportunity**
------------------------------------


You'll spend your time in the field building meaningful relationships with healthcare providers while representing technology that directly impacts patient care. Every day offers the opportunity to learn, grow, and build a rewarding career within one of the fastest\-growing sectors in healthcare.

jobs.description:
The Department of Medicine, Division of Cardiology has developed a clinical research infrastructure within the Division. The goals are to increase industry\-sponsored research, create a system that will assist a physician within the division to operationalize an investigator\-initiated study, and to develop a general cardiology cohort study. The purpose of this position is to carry out the needed tasks as a part of ongoing and future clinical and translational research projects in the Division of Cardiology.

  

Under the supervision of the Clinical Research Supervisor, the Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) will perform duties related to the support and coordination of clinical studies, and may receive training and development to prepare and advance to the next level within the series.

  

CRC duties may include, but will not be limited to, support the management of and coordinate the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies, depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports; help to coordinate staff work schedules to ensure proper coverage; assist with training of Assistant CRCs, and assist Clinical Research Supervisor and/or PI with oversight of other research staff; manage PI’s protocols in the Committee on Human Research online system, as well as renewals and modifications of protocol applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval and University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and perform other duties as assigned.

  

The Department of Medicine, Division of Cardiology has established a comprehensive, multi\-layered clinical research infrastructure to support and expand the Division’s research mission. This infrastructure supports industry\-sponsored research, facilitates investigator\-initiated studies, and advances a general cardiology cohort study, while offering clear opportunities for professional growth in clinical research operations and leadership.

  

The Cardiology Clinical Research Unit (CCRU) supports 100\-120 active clinical trials. The CCRU research portfolio covers phase I\- IV and post approval trial types and covers a diversity of trials ranging from pharmaceutical, device, preventative, and social behavioral research. Within the Division are sub\-specialty sections for: Adult Congenital Heart Disease; Advanced Heart Failure, Transplant, and Pulmonary Hypertension; Cardiac Electrophysiology; Critical Care Cardiology; Cardio\-Oncology and Immunology; Echocardiography and Cardiac Imaging; General Cardiology, Interventional Cardiology; and Prevention. The Division runs several clinical practices in multiple sites, conducts basic and clinical research, and educates medical students, residents, clinical fellows through ACGME as well as non\-ACGME training programs. In addition, the Division has significant and complex financial and administrative relationships with the Department of Medicine (DOM) and the UCSF Medical Center, as well as large patient care programs in the sections noted above, large clinical, Federal, and privately supported research programs and six faculty laboratories. The Division has 90 full\-time faculty, several non\-faculty academics, 36 clinical fellows, several post\-doctoral research fellows, and approximately 60 research support and administrative staff. The Division currently expends over $22 million per year in pursuit of its clinical, research, training, and service missions. While the Division is primarily split between the Parnassus and Mission Bay campuses, clinical fellows have rotations at the Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital and the San Francisco Veterans Affairs Medical Center.


  
Required Qualifications


* High School Diploma; or equivalent experience/training
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal skills; excellent, effective verbal and written communication skills to coordinate with subjects, team members, other departments and outside institutions; and the ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment while working with a diverse subject population
* Ability to work well independently, complete projects in a timely manner, and prioritize multiple projects to ensure the completion of essential tasks by deadlines
* Demonstrated ability to exercise tact and discretion in sensitive communications with patients and others. Demonstrated ability in handling a variety of confidential information appropriately.
* Demonstrated positive interpersonal skills and problem solving abilities
* Willing to travel (limited travel for investigator meetings)
  

Preferred Qualifications:


* Two\-year commitment
* Experience in clinical cardiology and clinical/cardiovascular research
* Science, research, or medical background
* Applied knowledge in drug and/or device trials
* Proficiency in the use of Committee of Human Research (CHR) online iMEDris system for submission, renewal, and modification of protocols through this system
* Understanding of patient population to create rapport, while also giving insight to what is realistic and appropriate for patient participation
* In\-depth knowledge of ICH/GCP and FDA requirements for INDs, IDEs, and NDAs

Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off\-price retailer.

**Job Description:**

**Opportunity: Grow Your Career**


Responsible for executing receiving and merchandising standards while ensuring Associates are processing efficiently and effectively, and working as a team. Ensures an excellent customer experience by engaging and interacting with all customers, and maintaining a clean and organized store. Role models exceptional customer service.

* Creates a positive internal and external customer experience
* Promotes a culture of honesty and integrity; maintains confidentiality
* Orchestrates truck delivery, prioritizing the processing of merchandise onto the sales floor
* Trains and mentors Associates on established merchandising and processing principles
* Ensures merchandise is properly tagged, hung, secured, and coded
* Communicates with the Coordinator on Duty to ensure efficient flow of goods to sales floor
* Ensures Associates complete tasks and activities according to store plan; prioritizes as needed
* Monitors productivity of team and coaches as necessary
* Organizes and rotates back stock for easy replenishment
* Maintains and upholds merchandising philosophy and signage standards
* Maintains all organizational, cleanliness and recovery standards for the backroom area
* Ensures compliance with recycling and, where applicable, hazardous waste programs
* Communicates accurately and effectively with management and Associates when setting and addressing priorities; provides progress updates
* Provides and accepts recognition and constructive feedback
* Partners with Management on Associate training needs to increase effectiveness
* Ensures adherence to all labor laws, policies, and procedures
* Promotes credit and loyalty programs
* Supports and participates in store shrink reduction goals and programs
* Promotes safety awareness and maintains a safe environment
* Other duties as assigned

**Who We’re Looking For: You.**

* Able to work a flexible schedule, including nights and weekends
* Superior communication and organizational skills with attention to detail
* Capable of multi\-tasking
* Able to respond appropriately to changes in direction or unexpected situations
* Team player, working effectively with peers and supervisors
* Capable of lifting heavy objects with or without reasonable accommodation
* Able to train others
* 1 year retail and 6 months of leadership experience

4490 Las Positas Road Space 102**Location:**

jobs.description:
**Benefits:**
* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Flexible schedule
  

**Marketing Assistant**

  

Founded in 2008, Tutu School is a quaint and whimsical collection of boutique ballet schools designed to foster creativity and joy while encouraging tiny dancers to fully exercise their imagination as well as bodies. With over 100 locations across the U.S. and Canada, Tutu School provides an imaginative curriculum that celebrates the magic of childhood and builds confidence through movement.  

We are Tutu Collective Inc., a proud multi\-unit franchisee of Tutu School. We currently operate 11 Tutu School locations across California, New York and Connecticut. We are hiring for a Marketing Assistant. This position will report directly to the Director of Business Operations.  

**Job Summary**

  

We are looking for a Marketing Assistant who thinks like a marketer and sells like a relationship builder. This role will support local marketing efforts across our regions with a strong focus on events, partnerships, community outreach, and lead generation.  

The goal of this position is not simply to create awareness, but to turn that awareness into action: new families discovering our brand, attending a trial class, and ultimately becoming members of our community.

  

You will be responsible for the full cycle of event and partnership planning, from identifying opportunities and pitching partners to preparing for events, coordinating staffing and logistics, communicating with partners, and following up afterward. You will often be the first interaction a business, organization, influencer, or community partner has with our brand, so professionalism, confidence, and strong communication are essential.

  

This is a highly collaborative role that works closely with our Director of Business Operations, Regional Directors, Social Media Coordinator, Marketing Coordinators, and teaching teams across multiple markets.
  

**Responsibilities**
**Event \& Partnership Marketing**
* Identify and pursue local events, partnership, sponsorship, and community marketing opportunities across our regions.
* Own the full event lifecycle, including research, outreach, pitching, preparation, staffing, execution, communication, and follow\-up.
* Confidently pitch partnerships through email, phone calls, video calls, and in\-person conversations.
* Build and maintain relationships with local businesses, organizations, schools, family\-focused brands, influencers, and community groups.
* Coordinate event logistics, materials, staffing, schedules, promotional assets, and on\-site needs.
* Represent the brand professionally at community events and partnership activations.
* Follow up with event attendees and leads with the goal of driving trial classes, studio visits, and memberships.
* Track partnership and event results and identify opportunities to improve future activations.

**Local Marketing \& Lead Generation**
* Support organic marketing initiatives designed to increase local brand awareness and drive new customer acquisition.
* Help develop creative ways to bring new families into our studios and communities.
* Support promotional campaigns, local outreach, community initiatives, and grassroots marketing efforts.
* Assist with influencer partnerships, collaborations, and local creator activations.
* Develop relationships that create ongoing referral and lead\-generation opportunities.

**Content \& Social Support**
* Work closely with the Social Media Coordinator to support content creation for events, partnerships, and local marketing initiatives.
* Assist with creating simple graphics, promotional materials, Reels, and other marketing content.
* Help capture content at events and partnership activations when needed.
* Maintain brand consistency across communications and marketing materials.
* Canva and Asana experience is a plus.

**Paid Marketing Support**
* While this role is primarily focused on organic and local marketing, you should be comfortable working alongside paid marketing efforts.
* Support paid social, boosted content, and other digital campaigns as needed.
* Understand how organic partnerships and events can complement paid marketing efforts.

**What We're Looking For**
* Strong sales and relationship\-building skills with the confidence to initiate conversations and pitch opportunities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Professional, polished, and comfortable being the first point of contact with a potential partner.
* Experience working with influencers, partnerships, events, community marketing, or business development.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
* Able to manage multiple events, partnerships, and deadlines across different regions.
* Self\-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
* Comfortable communicating with a wide range of people through email, phone, video calls, and in person.
* Creative and resourceful with the ability to think of new ways to connect with local families and businesses.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, multi\-location environment.
* Strong follow\-through and a proactive approach to communication.
* Experience with Canva and Asana is a plus.
* Comfortable working with social media and creating basic marketing content.
* Experience with paid social or digital advertising is a plus but not required.

**What Success Looks Like**
Success in this role means creating meaningful local connections that turn into measurable business results. You will help us expand our presence in each market, build strong community partnerships, generate new leads, and ultimately drive more families into our studios through trial classes and memberships.  

We are looking for someone who doesn't wait for opportunities to come to them. You see a local business, event, influencer, or organization and think, \\"How could we partner?\\" Then you confidently reach out, build the relationship, and make it happen

jobs.description:
**Hadrian \- Manufacturing the Future**
=======================================


Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full\-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission\-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

  

Following our $1\.37B Series D at a $7\.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory\-as\-a\-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

  

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

  

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

**The Role**
------------


Hadrian is hiring an Experiential Marketing Manager to own every moment where someone meets Hadrian in person. This is the single owner of our events portfolio, from a twelve\-person dinner in a private room to a flagship launch built around a working factory floor.


This role exists because physical experience is our highest\-conviction channel. The people we most want to reach, the engineers building autonomous systems and the machinists and technicians who run them, do not decide where to spend the next five years of their career because of an ad. They decide after they walk a floor, put their hands on a part, and talk to the people doing the work. Your job is to engineer that encounter and then run it at scale across multiple cities.


You will inherit a portfolio that is already in motion and under\-resourced, and you will own it end to end: strategy, calendar, budget, vendors, production, staffing, and the follow\-through that turns a good night into a hire or a customer conversation. This is a builder role with real budget and real autonomy, not a coordinator role executing someone else’s brief.

**Why Now**
-----------


We are scaling our manufacturing footprint across multiple sites and hiring aggressively into the Bay Area and beyond, and our events calendar is about to go from occasional to continuous. Several things are already live: recruiting\-driven dinners and socials, a multi\-month brand and talent campaign anchored in the Bay Area, and a set of factory and site moments tied to new capability launches. * Own the events budget, including vendor selection, negotiation, production spend, and reconciliation. Bring a point of view on where a dollar buys more experience.

**Build the flagship moments**

* Lead production on flagship brand and launch events, including the format decision, venue and site selection, run of show, talent and speaker logistics, and executive prep.
* Design factory and site experiences that let people see the machines and the work. Partner closely with site leadership and operations so that hosting visitors never compromises production, safety, or export\-control obligations.
* Sequence events against the broader campaign calendar, including out of home, content, and media moments, so that a launch reads as one connected push rather than several unrelated dates.

**Run the recruiting engine in person**

* Build a repeatable cadence of recruiting\-driven experiences: curated dinners and salons, technical talks and demo nights, happy hours near our sites, and targeted socials for specific engineering and skilled\-trade audiences.
* Partner with talent brand and recruiting on invite strategy, guest curation, and the handoff that turns an attendee into a pipeline candidate. Attendance is not the metric. Conversations and hires are.
* Develop formats that travel, so a dinner series or demo night can run in a new city without rebuilding it from scratch each time.

**Operate and measure**

* Stand up the operating infrastructure this function currently lacks: a single source\-of\-truth events calendar, briefing and run\-of\-show templates, vendor roster, budget tracker, and post\-event debriefs.
* Define what success means per event type before the event happens, then report honestly against it, including when something did not work.
* Manage agencies, production partners, and contract staff. Hold them to a standard and replace them when they miss it.

**Partner across the company**

* Partner with government relations and policy on conference presence and official visits as those functions come online.

jobs.description:
**Social Media \& Content Coordinator**

**Company:** Snapp Stats  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time Contract, with potential to convert to permanent full\-time  
**Compensation:** $55,000–$60,000 annualized, depending on experience  
**Location:** Remote / San Francisco preferred

**About Snapp**

Snapp is building AI for sports fans.

Our product helps fans follow their teams, manage fantasy leagues, track bets, get real\-time scores and analysis, and ask questions about sports through AI.

We're looking for a **Social Media \& Content Coordinator** who lives and breathes sports, social media, and internet culture.

This is a hands\-on, early\-career role supporting Snapp's social and content efforts across **organic social, paid social creative, and UGC creators**.

You won't be expected to own Snapp's entire social strategy. You'll work closely with our team to help execute it: creating and sourcing content, engaging with sports fans, developing creative for social ads, finding great UGC creators, and helping us produce more content, faster.

If you've grown a social following of your own, even better.

**What You'll Do**

**Support Organic Social**

You'll help keep Snapp active, relevant, and engaged across X, Instagram, TikTok, and other social platforms. You'll:

* Help create and publish daily organic content
* Monitor sports news, fantasy, betting, and trending conversations for content opportunities
* Help create memes, graphics, clips, short\-form videos, and social\-native posts
* Engage with fans through replies, comments, and quote posts
* Identify conversations and trending moments Snapp should participate in
* Help source interesting sports content, memes, clips, and ideas for the team
* Turn Snapp product features, sports data, and insights into engaging social content
* Assist with maintaining our content calendar and posting cadence

A big part of this role is understanding **what people actually want to engage with**, not just filling a content calendar.

**Help With Paid Social Creative**

You'll work alongside our growth team to help develop and source creative for Meta, TikTok, and other paid channels. You'll:

* Identify organic content and concepts that could translate into strong ads
* Brainstorm hooks, creative concepts, and new angles
* Source videos, clips, screenshots, and other creative assets
* Help create variations of winning ads and concepts
* Organize our paid creative library and pipeline
* Monitor competitor ads and emerging creative trends
* Help identify why certain creative is performing
* Turn winning ideas into additional creative variations

You don't need to be an experienced media buyer. We're looking for someone who understands **content and creative** and is excited to learn how that translates into paid growth.

**Find \& Curate UGC Creators**

A major part of this role will be helping us build and manage a network of creators who can produce content for Snapp. You'll:

* Find sports, fantasy, betting, and lifestyle creators who fit the Snapp brand
* Reach out to potential UGC creators
* Evaluate creators based on content quality, personality, and audience fit
* Maintain and organize our creator pipeline
* Help develop creator briefs, concepts, and talking points
* Coordinate creator deliverables and deadlines
* Review incoming UGC and provide feedback
* Identify our best\-performing creators and content
* Find creators we should work with repeatedly
* Help develop creators into longer\-term Snapp ambassadors
* Stay on top of emerging creators before everyone else finds them

We're looking for someone with a good eye for **potential**, not just someone who looks at follower counts.

**Drive Engagement**

We want Snapp to feel like part of the sports conversation, not a brand talking at people. You'll help:

* Reply to sports fans, creators, teams, and other accounts
* Jump into relevant conversations in real time
* Write replies that are funny, useful, or interesting
* Build relationships with sports and creator accounts
* Identify opportunities to turn engagement into new followers and users
* Experiment with different ways to increase comments, shares, and conversation

You should understand that sometimes **a great reply can be more valuable than the original post.**

**What We're Looking For**

We're looking for someone who:

* Is genuinely interested in sports
* Has a strong understanding of social media and internet culture
* Understands how sports fans communicate online
* Has strong instincts around what content will get attention
* Writes great captions, hooks, replies, and short\-form copy
* Is comfortable engaging with people online
* Understands TikTok, Instagram, X, and short\-form video
* Can identify good creators and content quickly
* Is highly organized and able to manage multiple projects at once
* Is comfortable moving quickly and testing lots of ideas
* Is willing to create, edit, source, organize, and execute
* Is interested in learning both organic and paid social

You do **not** need years of professional social media experience.

We're much more interested in whether you understand the internet and know how to create content people actually want to consume.

**Huge Plus If You Have**

* Grown your own social media following
* Built a sports, fantasy, betting, meme, or fan account
* Grown an account to 10K\+ followers
* Created TikToks, Reels, Shorts, or posts that generated significant organic reach
* Experience working with UGC creators
* Experience creating social ads
* Experience with Meta or TikTok creative
* Short\-form video editing experience
* Experience with fantasy sports or sports betting
* Built or helped manage an online community

If you've built an audience yourself, **show us.**

We care more about seeing what you've actually created than seeing a perfectly formatted résumé.

jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Sunnyvale, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in a customer\-facing role working with stakeholders, driving customer technical implementations or transformation programs.
* Experience supporting customers in cloud operations (e.g., launch or capacity planning, product release management), cloud technical support, cloud escalation management, or cloud consulting.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* MBA or Master’s degree in a management, technical, or engineering field.
* Experience translating business requirements into technological solutions.
* Experience in application or workload migration to public cloud providers.
* Experience collaborating with teams, groups, business units, channel partners, systems integrators, and third\-party developers to deliver high\-impact solutions.
* Understanding of IT operations, database systems, networking, IT security, application development, service architecture, cloud\-native application development, hosted services, storage systems, or content delivery networks.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, problem\-solving, and client management skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will help customers successfully adopt Google Cloud products. You will lead the successful adoption of Google Cloud at organizations, guiding them through the strategic and technical facets of their Google Cloud transformation journey. You'll manage the successful delivery of Cloud Consulting engagements to drive customer adoption of Google Cloud services. In this role, you will regularly engage with various stakeholder groups, including leadership of enterprises and a cross\-functional and geographically dispersed team.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $140000 \- $204000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Accelerate customer adoption of Google Cloud by leading the implementation journey. Provide technical guidance and manage timelines, milestones, migration goal and business transformation strategies.
* Advocate for customer needs in order to overcome adoption blockers and drive new feature development. Lead across multiple work streams and teams to maintain customer momentum.
* Develop relationships with stakeholders to understand customer’s business, develop strategic roadmaps, and lead quarterly business reviews and executive sessions to better understand business and technical needs.
* Plan for customer events and launches, partnering with Support, Engineers, and Site Reliability Engineers to ensure customer success, and work with customers and Support to guide issues/escalations to resolution.
* Develop best practices and assets based on learnings from customer engagements to support initiatives to scale through partners and accelerate Google Cloud adoption.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. The primary responsibility for Gordian Account Managers is to provide support, and training, for products and services centered around Job Order Contracting (JOC) for various Clients.

  

JOC is a procurement method and construction process that helps federal, state, and local governments, schools, hospitals, higher education institutions, and others maximize efficiency, optimize cost savings, and increase construction quality.

 **Primary Responsibilities**

* Prepare and maintain schedules of detailed activities to accomplish procurement objectives within a specified time period for clients
* Implement and adhere to project procedures from project identification, assistance in overseeing the development and review of project scope of work, proposal review, ensuring contract compliance, through notice to proceed, and construction execution necessary to accomplish a specific objective for various Job Orders
* Ability to read and understand construction plans and specifications, with a depth of knowledge in conducting a comprehensive price proposal review as well as creating and review detailed construction line\-item proposals
* Ability to train contractors in Gordian software, client procedure and assist in client contract bidding
* Communicate clearly and effectively with clients and internal team members to ensure projects are completed on time and on budget
* Manage multiple accounts; develop positive working relationships with all customers.
* Drive client retention, renewals, upsells and client satisfaction.
* Work closely with Project Managers and Account Managers on day\-to\-day operational processes including, but not limited to contract renewals, prepare and maintain schedules to accomplish procurement objectives, troubleshooting, provide software training to client and contractor staff.
* Work closely with to determine root cause of customer success and failures and drive requirements for process enhancement and development as needed.
* Partner with internal cross\-functional teams to understand customer goals and key performance metrics and exceed those goals yearly.
* Provide input on new processes and workflow as needed.
* Focus on ensuring we maintain superior customer service levels, operational excellence and strategic insight.
* Collaborate closely with construction management firms to promote consistency and while developing standards and procedures.
* Work closely with Finance on billing setup and invoicing.
* Participate in Budget development and management, revenue forecasting
* Work with Sales and Business Operations team to develop annual program usage and benchmark report.
* Ability to monitor and follow through on all construction/project related activities to ensure work adequately reflects clients' needs and is executed in a continuous, prompt manner within the project budget.
* Ability to review contractors' requests for changes and, if appropriate, initiate job order supplementals
* Ability to interact with owner representatives, contractors, and facility end\-users, to minimize project concerns.
* Experience reviewing contractor's’ daily inspection reports, summarizing, and reporting on construction progress weekly, to upper management.

* Extensive knowledge and experience in public construction operations, pricing and contracting, including scope development and estimating/price proposal development
* High level analytical skills and problem\-solving capabilities, and the ability to effectively manage several projects simultaneously in development and in the field during construction.
* Excellent customer service and communication skills, strong interpersonal and team building skills, flexibility, strategic thinking, problem solving skills, goal driven, client obsessed, ability to deliver results, meets client and corporate deadlines, time management skills, self\-motivated, works well independently and in a group dynamic
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products, including Word, Excel, PowerBi, ability to develop and generate custom tracking documents and reports
* Background in construction documentation and administration preferred, but not required
* Job Order Contracting or IDIQ experience is preferred, but not required, comprehensive understanding of various public procurement and project delivery methods and requirements.

jobs.title: Enterprise Implementation Specialist, Americas
jobs.description:
### **About Ahrefs**



Ahrefs is an all\-in\-one marketing intelligence platform used by marketers, businesses and agencies around the world. Our tools help people understand search demand, analyse competitors, improve website performance and research content opportunities, backed by 15 years of web crawling data and increasingly powered by AI.



We're bootstrapped and profitable, and we have been for 15 years. There are no investors and no board, which means no outside timeline on our decisions. We're multinational, with offices in Palo Alto, Cambridge (MA), Singapore and Tokyo, and our culture is fast\-moving, low\-ego, and built on smart decisions and ownership.


### **The role**



We're looking for an Enterprise Implementation Specialist to own the technical support and implementation after an enterprise customer signs.



That's the whole job, and it's a big one. You'll take a brand\-new Ahrefs Enterprise account from contract to fully live: setting up the account, migrating their keyword sets across from whatever they were using before, and running the onboarding training. When something breaks or someone gets stuck, you're who they reach. When renewal comes around, the reason they say yes is largely the work you did in the first ninety days.



You'll work directly alongside our Account Managers. They own the account strategy and the commercial relationship: where the customer is heading and what they need. You own making it real. It's a genuine partnership, and it only works if both halves are strong.



This role is based out of one of our offices, Palo Alto (CA) or Cambridge (MA). You can be based in whichever you have the legal right to work in, but this is an on\-site role. You'll serve customers across the Americas.


### **What you'll do**


* Run hands\-on account setup for new enterprise customers, configuring projects, workspaces, permissions and integrations to match how each customer actually works.
* Own keyword migrations end to end: audit what they have, map it across, move it, validate it, and make sure nothing quietly went missing.
* Deliver onboarding training to customer teams, from the SEO practitioners to marketing managers.
* Be the technical escalation point for your accounts: triage support requests, dig into the actual problem, resolve what you can, and drive what you can't to the right people internally.
* Turn what you learn into reusable assets (migration playbooks, training materials, documentation) so the tenth implementation is faster than the first.
* Feed real customer friction back to Product.

### **Must have**


* 3\-5 years in customer support, implementation, onboarding, technical account management, or a comparable hands\-on post\-sale role at a SaaS company.
* Direct experience taking enterprise customers live. You've owned a go\-live, not just supported one.
* Genuine comfort with data migration work: mapping, transforming, validating, and explaining to a customer why their 40,000 keywords came across as 39,847\.
* The ability to run a training session and have the attendees leave able to do the thing.
* Real technical range: APIs, integrations, CSVs, spreadsheets at scale, and the instinct to reproduce a bug before escalating it.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* The ability to figure things out independently.
* AI must be a part of your daily workflow.
* A "first do it, then do it right, then do it better" mentality. The tenth implementation should be faster or smoother than the first.

### **Nice to have**


* Working knowledge of SEO: keyword research, rank tracking, site audits, backlinks. You don't need to be a practitioner, but you should know what a customer means when they say their crawl budget is a problem.
* Hands\-on time with Ahrefs, or with a competing enterprise SEO platform.
* Experience with enterprise onboarding at scale.
* Experience working next to an account management or CS function.

### **What success looks like**


**In 6 months:** you'll be running enterprise implementations independently, start to finish. Account Managers will be routing technical questions to you by default rather than escalating them upward.


**In 1 year:** you'll be the person who knows more about how enterprise customers deploy Ahrefs at scale than anyone else in the company. You'll have a clear process and a view of where implementation should be automated rather than repeated.



Ahrefs does not engage with agencies or third\-party recruitment providers for the roles we hire for. If we need help, we'll let you know.


**Location:** Palo Alto (CA) or Cambridge (MA). On\-site.


Ahrefs does not engage with agencies or third party recruitment solutions for the roles we hire for. If at any point we need help, we'll let you know!
