jobs.title: Cardiovascular Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Description**


The Cardiovascular Sales Representative (CSR) is responsible for achieving or exceeding sales goals within an assigned geography while operating in a compliant and ethical manner. This role develops and executes territory strategies, identifies customer needs, and drives results. Using strong analytical skills, the CSR evaluates regional market data to build and implement strategic territory business plans, foster lasting professional relationships, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional partners. The ideal candidate has strong business acumen, is resourceful, self\-motivated, results\-oriented, and collaborative.

**Responsibilities**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key customers and accounts with the goal of maximizing sales.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with targeted physicians to maximize new business opportunities.
* Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross\-functional discipline is critical. Cross\-functional partners may consist of FRMs, TLLs, Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers.
* Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources such as next best action, to determine strategies and tactics for business decision\-making.
* Demonstrate account\-based selling skills (including group presentations, etc.).
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company’s brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in training and development programs.
* Comply with all legal, regulatory and compliance policies and demonstrate a high level of integrity and professionalism at all times.
* Additional duties as required.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Business or a related field required.
* 3\+ years of pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical sales experience.
* 2\+ years of cardiovascular/cardiometabolic strongly preferred.
* Experience in highly managed, payor\-controlled markets is strongly preferred.
* Consistent track record of documented top\-tier sales accomplishments.
* Experience calling on assigned targets in the designated territory geography highly desired.
* Experience launching products in competitive marketplace.
* Ability to learn complex scientific information, apply technical proficiency and effectively communicate.
* Must be self\-motivated and able to work with a high level of autonomy and independence.
* Strong technical \& analytical skills including proficiency with CRM, AI tools and Microsoft Office Suite.
* A valid driver’s license and ability to travel as needed, which may include overnight and/or weekend travel.

  

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $120,000 to $130,000\. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.


At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Our ability to collaborate and problem\-solve makes a difference in patients’ lives daily. By joining one of our account management teams, you will partner with industry experts and be empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy needed to successfully navigate the complex market access landscape. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.


Work Here Matters Everywhere \| How are you inspired to change lives?

*Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*


At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality\-of\-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos Health complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

jobs.title: Hospital-Based Violence Intervention Program (HVIP) - Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY**

The HVIP Program Coordinator is responsible for coordinating daily program operations across University Hospital (UH) and Newark Beth Israel Medical Center (NBI). The position coordinates Community Health Workers (CHWs), manages program data and reporting, monitors operational activities, and maintains communication with hospital personnel, NCST leadership, and community partners.

The coordinator ensures consistent program implementation, accurate documentation, timely reporting, effective communication, and follow\-through across both hospital sites. This position works under the direction of the Director of HVIP and is accountable for maintaining organized, efficient, and responsive program operations.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

1\. Multi\-Site Program Coordination

* Coordinate daily HVIP operations across University Hospital and Newark Beth Israel.
* Monitor program activities, referrals, participant follow\-ups, and outstanding operational tasks at both sites.
* Maintain consistent workflows, documentation procedures, and program standards across hospital locations.
* Coordinate hospital meetings, on\-site activities, and communication with designated hospital contacts.
* Identify operational barriers, service gaps, and site\-specific needs and communicate them to NCST leadership.
* Maintain trackers for assignments, deadlines, meetings, and unresolved concerns. ● Provide regular updates on program activities, challenges, and outcomes across both locations.

2\. Community Health Worker Coordination

* Provide day\-to\-day operational coordination and support to CHWs assigned to both hospital sites.
* Conduct weekly check\-ins to review caseloads, participant needs, service plans, documentation, and follow\-up responsibilities.
* Monitor completion of assigned tasks and communicate outstanding responsibilities to CHWs.
* Reinforce NCST policies, hospital protocols, documentation standards, and professional expectations.
* Support CHWs in coordinating participant services and addressing barriers to care.
* Identify recurring workflow, communication, or performance concerns and escalate matters requiring supervisory intervention to NCST leadership.
* Ensure CHWs receive timely updates regarding program procedures, hospital expectations, and operational changes.

3\. Data Management and Reporting

* Manage HVIP data collection, data entry, data quality assurance, and reporting across both hospital sites.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and timely participant and program records in designated systems.
* Monitor documentation and data entry for missing information, inconsistencies, and overdue records.
* Develop and maintain data trackers, caseload reports, service utilization reports, and program dashboards as needed.
* Track participant encounters, referrals, service connections, follow\-up activities, and program outcomes.
* Prepare weekly reports distinguishing UH and NBI activity while providing combined program totals.
* Compile reports for NCST leadership, hospital partners, and funders as assigned.
* Identify trends, reporting discrepancies, and service gaps and communicate findings to NCST leadership.
* Maintain confidentiality and compliance with applicable data security and recordkeeping requirements.

4\. Participant Services and Care Coordination

* Support CHWs in coordinating participant access to healthcare, behavioral health, housing, transportation, employment, and community resources.
* Monitor referrals, service plans, and follow\-up activities to support continuity of care.
* Help identify barriers to participant engagement and coordinate appropriate referrals and internal support.
* Support communication between participants, CHWs, hospital personnel, and community providers while maintaining confidentiality and participant choice.
* Escalate participant\-related concerns requiring clinical, supervisory, or executive decisions to the appropriate personnel.

5\. Hospital and Community Partner Communication

* Maintain professional working relationships with University Hospital, Newark Beth Israel, NCST personnel, and community partners.
* Attend assigned hospital and partner meetings.
* Communicate program updates, operational needs, and action items to relevant stakeholders.
* Follow established communication protocols and supervisory structures when addressing hospital or partner concerns.
* Provide written follow\-up on significant meetings and operational discussions, including decisions, assigned responsibilities, and outstanding matters.
* Coordinate communication between hospital sites when operational issues affect both locations.
* Promptly communicate concerns involving participant services, CHW assignments, hospital operations, or interagency coordination to the appropriate NCST supervisor.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities across two hospital sites.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong data management, reporting, documentation, and quality assurance skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, databases, and related reporting tools.
* Ability to follow established procedures, supervisory direction, and communication protocols.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively with hospital staff, CHWs, community partners, and participants.
* Knowledge of healthcare coordination, community resources, and barriers to care.
* Demonstrated professionalism, accountability, sound judgment, attention to detail, and follow\-through.
* Understanding of trauma\-informed, survivor\-centered, and culturally responsive services.

Pay: Up to $73,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Education:

* High school or equivalent (Required)

Experience:

* Community Health: 3 years (Preferred)
* Program Coordination : 3 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: College Preparatory Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Harlem Children’s Zone (HCZ) — a world\-renowned education and poverty\-fighting organization based in New York — seeks an enthusiastic, dedicated, and mission\-aligned College Preparatory Program Coordinator to support the College Success Office.


The College Success Office (CSO) provides year\-round academic, administrative, and emotional support, as well as financial and career preparation, to participants in HCZ’s Promise Academy high schools and afterschool programs. Our mission is to ensure our participants have the resources and guidance they need to succeed in college and beyond. The main components of the CSO include: scholar outreach, academic support and guidance, financial aid advisement, college transfer assistance, summer and winter internship opportunities, and community building efforts within our program.


We are currently seeking two College Prep Program Coordinators, one for our Promise Academy scholars and another for our Zone After\-School Programs. The College Preparatory Program Coordinators provide leadership, supervision, and strategic oversight for the College Preparatory Program team serving HCZ’s Promise Academy scholars or the team serving our Zone After\-School programs. The Coordinator is responsible for ensuring the successful implementation of college preparation, college access, matriculation, and postsecondary transition programming by supervising a team of College Preparatory Program Counselors and establishing best practices across either Promise Academy or the Zone After\-School programs.


The ideal candidate is an experienced college access professional with demonstrated success in staff supervision, program development, cross\-functional collaboration, and data\-driven decision\-making. This individual will lead initiatives that promote a strong college\-going culture, strengthen scholar and family engagement, and increase postsecondary enrollment and persistence outcomes for HCZ scholars.


For more information, check out **Want to Work at Harlem Children’s Zone? Here’s 7 Things You Need to Know**

 **Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree (master's preferred) in Higher Education, School Counseling, Educational Leadership, Student Affairs, Social Work, or a related field required.
* At least 2\-3\+ years of experience in college admissions, college counseling, student advising, and the use of data\-driven methods to increase scholar admission to and matriculation into college.

**Who you are**

* Knowledge of admissions, enrollment policies, financial aid, and postsecondary education.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to complete tasks accurately and in a timely manner.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Outlook.
* Ability and willingness to work a flexible schedule to accommodate the needs of the program, including evenings, some weekends, and travel as required on weekdays and weekends.

**What you'll do**

* Supervise, coach, and support a team of College Preparatory Program Counselors, and ensure the consistent implementation of college\-preparation services across assigned Zone high school after\-school sites or in collaboration with Promise Academy school leadership.
* Implement college\-preparation strategies, policies, and procedures to support scholar enrollment and success in postsecondary education.
* Provide ongoing training, professional development, and guidance to College Preparatory Program Counselors on college admissions, financial aid, and college counseling best practices.
* Develop and facilitate college\-related classes for scholars during Day School hours.
* Partner with leadership and program staff to support scholars' college planning needs, including college fairs, FAFSA workshops, college signing celebrations, and other college transition initiatives.
* Develop and facilitate workshops for scholars and families on college admissions, financial aid, scholarships, and postsecondary opportunities
* Monitor college application, enrollment, and matriculation data to identify trends and improve program outcomes.
* Coordinate program events, including college fairs, FAFSA workshops, college signing celebrations, and other college transition initiatives.
* Support and maintain partnerships with colleges and universities to expand opportunities for scholars.
* Remain abreast of trends in higher education, college admissions, and financial aid to ensure timely and relevant information is shared with scholars, families, and staff.
* Collaborate with the Evaluation team to track scholar outcomes and assess program effectiveness.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Schedule**

* Monday \- Friday; schedule may vary (e.g., 8 am \- 4 pm or 11 am \- 7 pm) based on scholar and program needs.
* Some weekends and evenings, depending on site needs and events; occasional travels

 **Benefits**  

As a member of the Harlem Children's Zone team, you will join a supportive and inclusive community dedicated to helping children, families — and our staff — thrive. We offer highly competitive salaries, a comprehensive benefits package, and opportunities for growth.

***Our exceptional full\-time benefits include:***

* Highly competitive base salaries
* Paid time off
* Employee referral bonus
* Career Advancement
* No\-cost health insurance
* Life Insurance
* Short\-and long\-term disability
* Additional voluntary benefits
* Wellness discounts
* Commuter benefits
* Financial wellness perks
* Additional Benefits (Discounts on flights, hotels, theme parks, concert tickets, and more.)

  

We offer competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. The salary range is $70,000 to $80,000\. To be considered, interested applicants should submit their applications directly through the posting. No telephone inquiries or recruiters, please. Replies will only be sent to qualified applicants. HCZ is an EOE.

evening and weekend work required; additional hours may be pre\-approved by the Senior Program Manager during periods of high delivery demands.

Edconic is a successful group of education businesses, including Sotheby’s Institute of Art, The School of The New York Times, Manchester City Sports Business School, and Vogue College of Fashion. Its mission is to build compelling education programs in partnership with the world’s best brands. The Pre\-College and Collegiate Division (PCD) supports its expansion and plans for growth by working across schools on the development and delivery of non\-MA programs.


 The Program Coordinator, Collegiate Programs role is integral to the delivery of Collegiate Program within Sotheby’s Institute of Art – New York, Vogue College of Fashion – New York, and School of the New York Times. Sotheby’s Institute of Art, founded by Sotheby’s Auction House in 1969, has pioneered the education of arts professionals and offers a wide range of Masters’ degrees, semester courses, and professional programs. Since 2004, Vogue College of Fashion has been providing students with the knowledge, networks and practical experience to become future leaders in the fashion industry and offers a range of degree and non\-degree programs. Collegiate (undergraduate) academic courses are validated by the University of Montana.

 The Program Coordinator plays an essential role in the preparation and successful delivery of Collegiate Programs. Reporting to the Senior Program Manager, this role supports the planning, developing, and execution of program delivery and contributing to the overall operations of Collegiate, ensuring a well\-organized program.


The role includes responsibilities such as coordinating co\-curricular activities, onboarding faculty and guest speakers, handling class materials, overseeing logistics, and facilitating communication between staff, faculty, guest speakers and students. The Program Coordinator also supports student needs and assists with general operational tasks throughout the program.


Serving as a primary point of contact for students and course leaders, the Program Coordinator will liaise with internal departments including facilities and IT. They will also work closely with colleagues to provide consistent, high\-quality administrative support to both students and staff.


This is a full\-time position that requires **on\-site support** during program delivery, or as directed by the Senior Program Manager. The role will include some evening and weekend hours, as well as additional duties as required with reasonable notice.

The Program Coordinator plays a vital role in supporting the planning and delivery of Collegiate programs, ensuring a high\-quality and well\-organized experience for students, faculty, and partners. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* **Program Delivery \& Operations:**  

 Support the coordination and execution of all on\-the\-ground program operations, including scheduling, catering, transportation, classroom logistics, and site visits. Ensure all activities run smoothly and efficiently.
* **Site Visits \& Events Coordination:**  

Organize, book, and track logistics for site visits, co\-curricular activities, and student events. Serve as a chaperone when needed.
* **Classroom \& Materials Management:**  

 Prepare and distribute class materials, supplies, and resources, ensuring all program\-related materials are delivered accurately and on time.

	+ Provide ongoing support to faculty and assist with faculty\-related activities and events. Meet with faculty prior to the program to review course content, identify teaching support needs, and confirm classroom requirements.
* **Communication \& Stakeholder Coordination:**  

 Act as a key point of contact for students, faculty, and course leaders. Manage program communications, including monitoring shared inboxes, and facilitating coordination with internal departments (Facilities and IT) and external vendors.
* **Student Support \& Welfare:**  

 Provide day\-to\-day support to students, responding to inquiries and addressing concerns. Monitor student wellbeing and escalate issues as appropriate to senior staff. Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and supportive environment.
* **Administrative \& Financial Support:**  

 Maintain accurate records, track budgets, process invoices, and support financial reporting. Assist with purchasing tickets, supplies, and other program\-related items.
* **Systems \& Data Management:**  

 Maintain student\-facing platforms (e.g., Canvas) with up\-to\-date schedules, course materials, and resources. Track and manage program data using internal systems.
* **Program Activities \& Engagement:**  

 Support in organizing and delivering virtual and in\-person pre\-program orientations, in\-person orientation sessions, ongoing student engagement

**Title: Customer Operations Coordinator**

**Location: New York, NY**

 **Who we are:**

**Voted one of the Nation's Best and Brightest Companies to Work for, Kuraray America, Inc. (KAI)** is a global leader in specialty chemical, fiber, and resin production. With top\-of\-the\-line research and production facilities and a vast network of supplies from around the world, Kuraray leads the industry in specialty dental, fiber, resin, and elastomer products. Kuraray America is a wholly owned subsidiary of Kuraray Company, Ltd. Based in Tokyo, Japan. Kuraray has operations in 32 countries and employs more than 12,000 employees, including over 800 in the United States.

**Why Kuraray:**


Kuraray is building a better tomorrow, today. Our team members are dedicated to expanding our business with committed professionals who share essential values such as integrity, excellence, teamwork, and accountability.


As a part of Kuraray America, Inc., our team shares the advantages of working for the leader in specialty chemicals, resins, and fibers. Our international presence and resources allow us to be a world\-leading innovator in the industries we service. Yet, despite our size, our people are more than just a number. As a new team member, you can expect to earn responsibility quickly. Our commitment to our people is visible in our comprehensive benefits package. As a Kuraray team member, you will have the opportunity to enjoy competitive salaries and benefits, incentive opportunities, and an excellent work environment.

 **Position Summary:**

  



The Customer Operations Coordinator supports customer service, order management, dealer support, sample fulfillment, and operational activities for the Dental business. This role serves as a key liaison between customers, dealers, sales representatives, third\-party logistics providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure orders, shipments, customer data, invoicing, and related business processes are managed accurately and efficiently. The position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining a high level of customer service.

**Responsibilities:**

 **Customer Service \& Order Management**

* Support the complete order lifecycle, including order entry, order maintenance, fulfillment coordination, and customer follow\-up activities.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for customers, dealers, sales representatives, and internal stakeholders regarding orders, shipments, and related inquiries.
* Maintain accurate customer, dealer, pricing, order, and shipment information within company systems.
* Assist with customer\-specific requirements, documentation requests, and account\-related updates.

 **Operations \& Logistics Coordination**

* Coordinate with third\-party logistics providers, warehouse partners, and internal teams to support product availability, order fulfillment, and shipment execution.
* Monitor inventory and shipment activity and communicate potential supply or fulfillment issues to appropriate stakeholders.
* Assist in resolving order, shipment, inventory, and operational issues to support customer satisfaction and business continuity.

 **Business Process \& Administrative Support**

* Support invoicing, sales data administration, reporting, chargebacks, expense processing, and other operational activities as needed.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and recommend practical solutions to improve efficiency, accuracy, and customer experience.
* Maintain records and perform responsibilities in accordance with company policies, internal controls, and applicable quality standards.

 **Additional Responsibilities**

* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

 **Minimum Qualifications:**

  

* HS Diploma or equivalent **AND** 1\-3 years in customer service, order management, sales operations, logistics, or related support functions
* Experience supporting customer service, order management, sales operations, logistics coordination, or related business processes.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with customers, dealers, vendors, logistics providers, sales teams, and internal stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage accurate business records and transactions.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Outlook.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work independently in a hybrid or remote environment.
* Strong organizational, problem\-solving, and follow\-through skills.
* Ability to identify operational issues and escalate appropriately.
* This candidate must reside in New York.
* This role has 10% of travel.

 **Competencies**:

* Customer Focus
* + Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer\-centric solutions.
* Business Insight
* + Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization's goals.
* Cultivates Innovation
* + Creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful.
* Action Oriented
* + Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.
* Ensures Accountability
* + Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.
* Drives Results
* + Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstance
* Collaborates
* + Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
* Values Difference
* + Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization
* Communicates Effectively
* + Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
* Courage
* + Stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said.

jobs.title: Investment Office Coordinator/Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**Overview**  

The Investment Office is responsible for the Library's $2\.0 billion endowment investment program. Though the Library receives substantial funding from the City of New York as an independent nonprofit entity, the endowment's spending provides crucial ongoing support for the Library's annual operating budget. The endowment portfolio is invested through external managers and is currently allocated across various asset classes and strategies, including domestic and international equities, marketable alternatives, private capital, real assets, and fixed income.  

Reporting to the Chief Investment Officer, the Investment Office Coordinator provides the administrative and operational foundation for a lean, flat investment team. The Coordinator owns Investment Committee and general meeting coordination, complex domestic and international travel logistics, expense and procurement processing, document management, and day\-to\-day office operations, and is often the first point of contact for external guests and investment managers visiting the office.  

**Expectations**
**A few examples of expectations for this person are that within:**
**1 month, this person will:**
* Become familiar with the Investment Office's financial, scheduling, and file management systems, including Workday, Concur, and Dynamo
* Begin managing recurring meeting logistics and travel bookings for the team

**3 months, this person will:**
* Independently manage the full travel and expense lifecycle, from research and booking through reconciliation
* Take ownership of meeting planning, materials assembly, and post\-meeting documentation, including Investment Committee minutes
* Proactively manage office supplies, equipment tracking, and asset tagging

**6 months and beyond, this person will:**
* Assist with broader operational support, including sending notifications as part of annual audit confirmation processes
* Identify and implement workflow improvements for scheduling, document management, and office administration

**Responsibilities**
* **Investment Committee meetings:** Coordinate the assembly and distribution of meeting materials, draft and distribute minutes, manage signatures with Legal, and maintain meeting archives.
* **General meeting coordination:** Schedule and reserve meeting rooms for team activities and manager meetings, and manage associated AV, facilities, hospitality, and catering needs.
* **Travel management:** Research and book comprehensive domestic and international travel itineraries, secure visas, maintain travel spreadsheets, and work within the travel management portal (Concur) and with internal purchasing and procurement teams.
* **Financial and budget administration:** Create and reconcile requisitions, expense reports, and purchasing card transactions in Workday; monitor departmental budgets; request quotes; and process contracts through execution.
* **Office operations:** Order and maintain supplies, office equipment, and technology, coordinating with internal service teams as needed.
* **Document management:** Maintain the Investment Office's filing structure across Dynamo and the shared drive, handling confidential investment documents with discretion.
* **Guest relations:** Greet external guests, offer hospitality, and ensure a professional experience for visitors to the Investment Office.
* **Ad hoc support:** Assist with compliance documentation, subscription documents, and other projects as directed by the Chief Investment Officer.
Application Deadline
October 21, 2026
Department
Investment Office
Employment Type
Full Time
Location
270 Madison Avenue
Workplace type
Hybrid
Compensation
$90,000 \- $98,000 / year
Reporting To
Geetanjali Gupta
**Required Education, Experience \& Skills**
--------------------------------------------

**Required Education and Certifications**
* College Degree


**Required Experience**
* 5\+ years of administrative or operational experience, preferably in a fast\-paced professional environment
* Experience coordinating domestic and international travel logistics
* Experience with expense reporting and financial systems (Workday preferred)

**Required Skills**
* Superior organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to manage complex and frequently changing calendars
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and comfort learning new systems and applications
* Working knowledge of generative AI and office technologies, and an interest in applying them to scheduling and administrative workflows
* Ability to act proactively, manage multiple competing priorities, and maintain a high level of attention to detail
* Professional demeanor and excellent written and verbal communication skills for interacting with senior staff, Board and Investment Committee members, investment managers, and external guests
* Ability to maintain strict confidentiality and handle sensitive financial and investment documents with discretion

**Managerial/Supervisory Responsibilities**
* None; this position has no direct or indirect reports

**More...**
-----------

**Core Values**  

*All team members are expected and encouraged to embody the NYPL Core Values:*
* Be **Helpful** to patrons and colleagues
* Be **Resourceful** in solving problems
* Be **Curious** in all aspects of your work
* Be **Welcoming** and **Inclusive**

**Work Environment**
* Office setting, with an on\-site presence required for meeting management and daily office operations
* Hybrid schedule: 3 days on\-site, 2 days remote (subject to change)

**Physical Duties**
* Limited physical effort is required


**Pre\-Placement** **Physical Required?**
* No


**Union/Non Union**
* Non\-Union


**FLSA Status**
* Non\-Exempt


**Schedule**
* 35 hours per week, Monday\-Friday, 9:00am\-5:00pm
* Flexibility required around Investment Committee meetings, team travel, and urgent operational needs

*This job description represents the types and levels of responsibilities

jobs.description:
**Position Type:**  

  

Administrative and Central Office

  

  

  

**Office Title/Functional Title:**  

  

Policy Development Coordinator, Early Childhood, DECE \- 27219

Manhattan

10/14/2026  

  

  

  

  

**Description:**  

  

**Position Summary:** The Division of Early Childhood Education (DECE) supports the operational and programmatic functions of early childhood education programs for New York City children in elementary schools, Pre\-K Centers and New York City Public Schools (NYCPS) contracted settings included in Community Based Organizations (CBO) and through Family Childcare (FCC) programs. DECE provides families with access to high quality, inclusive early childhood programs for children birth to five, in rich diverse settings, supporting children’s growth and development. Working together with families and programs, DECE ensures that children are engaged, nurtured and supported.
The Policy Development Coordinator will support the Manager and Director of Policy Development in advancing critical policy initiatives for DECE. The Coordinator will play a key role in supporting research, implementation and monitoring of policy priorities that ensure alignment with NYCPS, City and State requirements. This role will assist in data collection and analysis, development of policy materials and coordination of cross functional efforts that support the integration of early childhood programs into the broader Birth–12th grade education system. Performs related work.


**Reports to:** Manager of Policy Development, DECE  

**Direct Reports:** N/A  

**Key Relationships:** Division of Early Childhood Education central and field teams; relevant Central NYCPS teams; NYCPS field offices and staff; New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH); NYC Administration for Children’s Services (ACS); New York State Office of Children and Family Services (OCFS); other City, State and Federal agencies; and program leaders in district schools, community based early childhood centers and Family Child Care Networks.  

**Responsibilities**
* Assist in the development, implementation and monitoring of policy initiatives that support DECE priorities and early childhood program quality.
* Support the design and administration of surveys, data collection tools and feedback mechanisms to inform policy development.
* Conduct research and gather information on local, State, and Federal policies, regulations and legislation impacting early childhood education.
* Assist in drafting policy briefs, guidance documents, presentations and communications for internal and external audiences.
* Support the development of policies related to enrollment, staffing, program budgets, compliance and other key early childhood topics.
* Coordinate with internal and external partners to support alignment of DECE policy with broader NYCPS and regulatory requirements.
* Assist in monitoring compliance with City, State and Federal regulations across early childhood programs.
* Analyze data and support the identification of trends, challenges, and opportunities to improve policy implementation.
* Support the preparation of reports, presentations and materials for DECE leadership and stakeholders.
* Assist in planning and coordinating meetings, trainings, and professional development sessions related to policy implementation.
* Maintain organized documentation and track progress toward policy related milestones and deliverables.
* Provide general project management support to ensure timely advancement of policy initiatives.

**Qualification Requirements:**  

**Minimum**  

* A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two (2\) years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties described above; or


* High school graduation or equivalent and six (6\) years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties as described above; or


* Education and/or experience which is equivalent to “1” or “2” above. However, all candidates must have at least one (1\) year of experience as described in “1” above.


*Plus*


In addition to meeting the minimum requirements, individuals must have two additional years of relevant work experience.

  

**Preferred**
* Experience supporting policy development, research, or program implementation in education or public sector settings.
* Knowledge of NYCPS policy and procedures and the ability to interpret and apply policies effectively, particularly within early childhood education.
* Familiarity with DOHMH Article 43 and 47 regulations, OCFS Child Care regulations, and Head Start Program Performance Standards (HSPPS).
* Strong research and analytical skills, including experience working with data to inform decision making.
* Excellent written and spoken communication skills.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Ability to organize and present information clearly and concisely to a variety of audiences.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
* High attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate documentation.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 applications.

**Salary**: $72,114 \- $80,000

  

(Internal candidates who are selected for this position and who currently hold comparable or less senior positions within the DOE will not earn less than their current salary.)

  

**Please include a resume and cover letter with your application.**


**NOTE: The filling of all positions is subject to budget availability and/or grant funding.**

  

**\* New York City Residency is NOT Required \***

jobs.description:
Description:
**About MCM**

  

MCM (Modern Creation München) is a luxury lifestyle goods and fashion house founded in 1976 with an attitude defined by cultural Zeitgeist and German heritage. With a focus on functional innovation and a bold, aspirational spirit, MCM connects with a global audience across music, art, travel, and technology. Distributed in over 650 stores worldwide, MCM is driven to revolutionize classic design with futuristic materials for the 21st Century Global Nomad.


Requirements:
**Position Overview**

**Position Overview**


The CRM Coordinator supports MCM’s global CRM and clienteling operations, with a primary focus on the Americas and support for multi\-region initiatives and platform rollouts. This hands\-on role keeps CRM running day to day: building client segments, safeguarding data quality, serving as first\-line support for clienteling and CRM tools, and producing the reporting that shows how client programs perform. Working closely with Retail, Business Intelligence, Digital, Learning \& Development, IT, and global CRM partners, the CRM Coordinator helps turn client data into action for store teams, executing outreach tied to product launches, seasonal moments, and client development programs. The ideal candidate is organized, data\-minded, and service\-oriented, and is energized by making tools and processes work better for the people who use them.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage day\-to\-day CRM operations, independently determining segmentation criteria and building client segments and outreach lists that support product launches, seasonal moments, client reactivation, and VIP programs.
* Recommend refinements to and ensure client tiering and segmentation logic is applied consistently across CRM and clienteling tools.
* Serve as first\-line support for CRM and clienteling tools—triage store issues, manage vendor support tickets through resolution, track release updates, and communicate changes to the field.
* Support user access and login processes for retail teams in partnership with IT, in accordance with company data\-access and security policies.
* Maintain high standards of data accuracy across CRM, clienteling, and related systems; support data governance and client consent practices in line with applicable privacy laws and company policy so client data remains accurate and compliant.
* Own recurring CRM performance reporting in partnership with the Business Intelligence team, tracking KPIs such as client retention, reactivation, outreach and appointments, data capture, platform adoption, and campaign ROI; flag trends and data\-quality issues and recommend corrective actions.
* Monitor CRM and clienteling adoption across stores and recommend actions to strengthen engagement and operational efficiency.
* Participate in user acceptance testing for new integrations, data flows, campaigns, and platform enhancements, providing hands\-on feedback before rollout.
* Maintain CRM process documentation, user guides, and standard operating procedures so knowledge is accessible, current, and transferable.
* Partner with Learning \& Development to train store teams on CRM tools and new features, and support onboarding new hires to client\-facing systems.
* Collaborate with Retail, Merchandising, Digital, Business Intelligence, and global CRM teams to align campaigns with brand objectives and ensure consistency across markets.
* Partner with stores, customer service, and Voice of Customer teams to gather client feedback and integrate insights into CRM strategies.

**Experience \& Key Competencies**

* Minimum 2 years’ experience in CRM, clienteling, marketing operations, or a related field.
* Hands\-on experience within the Salesforce ecosystem; experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and clienteling applications (e.g., Proximity) a plus.
* Working knowledge of CRM and clienteling platforms, marketing automation/journey tools, customer data platforms, and POS/transaction systems.
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create clear, visually compelling reports and dashboards; familiarity with SQL or data platforms a plus.
* Strong attention to detail and data management discipline.
* Data\-driven mindset with the ability to analyze client behavior, evaluate campaign performance, and translate findings into practical recommendations.
* Service\-oriented troubleshooter who stays calm under pressure and follows issues through to resolution.
* Clear, organized writer who can document processes and explain tools simply to non\-technical users.
* Comfort using company\-approved AI tools, in line with MCM’s AI and data\-use policies, to improve productivity and client communication.
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Strong interpersonal skills for working effectively across regions, time zones, and business functions; able to occasionally accommodate early\-morning or evening calls with global partners.
* Quick learner who adapts well to change and thrives in a collaborative, fast\-paced team environment.
* Previous experience in retail or luxury fashion preferred.

**Salary \& Benefits**

* The base salary range listed above reflects what MCM in good faith expects to pay for this role at the time of posting; final offers are based on experience, skills, and internal equity
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Paid time off and holidays
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Employee product discount
* Opportunity to work in a global luxury retail environment

**Unique Challenges \& Opportunities**

* Coordinating initiatives across multiple markets and regions with varying time zones and business needs.
* Exposure to global luxury retail CRM strategy and multi\-market campaign execution.
* Hands\-on involvement in both the operational and creative sides of CRM, with the opportunity to influence how client engagement evolves.

jobs.description:
**About Gap Inc.**
------------------


At Gap Inc., we create culture as much as we create clothes. Our ambition is to become a high\-performing house of iconic American brands that shape culture.


Our portfolio—Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic, and Athleta—each brings a distinct point of view to how we show up in the world and serve our customers.


Old Navy democratizes style with quality and value for all. Gap champions originality through essential pieces that celebrate individuality. **Position Overview:**


Jewish National Fund\-USA is seeking a Temporary Culinary \& Events Coordinator to prepare and cook food for meetings and events, coordinate JNF House rentals, and support catering and event operations.

  

  

This is a hands\-on role combining food preparation, hospitality, and event coordination. The position requires experience working with kosher food preparation and service requirements, as well as flexibility to support events that may take place during evenings and weekends.

  

  

This temporary, part\-time hourly position is based in our New York City office and is expected to run from October through January, with the possibility of extension based on organizational needs.

  

  

**Job Responsibilities:**

**Physical Requirements:**


* Ability to stand for extended periods while preparing and serving food.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============


Serval is an AI\-native automation platform transforming how enterprises operate. We build intelligent agents that understand real\-world workflows and execute them end\-to\-end — replacing manual processes and rigid legacy systems with adaptive, learning software. Founded in early 2024, Serval is already trusted by companies like Fox, Notion, Perplexity, Vercel, and Brex to automate high\-volume, high\-friction operational work across their organizations.  

  

At the core of Serval is an agentic AI platform that turns natural language into production\-grade workflows. Our agents don’t just respond to requests — they reason, take action across systems, and continuously improve with usage. What began with operational use cases has quickly evolved into a horizontal AI automation layer used across IT, HR, Finance, Security, Legal, and Engineering.  

  

Our mission is to eliminate repetitive, manual work across the enterprise and give teams leverage through intelligent automation. Long term, we’re building the universal AI operations layer — a system of agents that sits across business functions and runs the workflows that keep modern companies moving.  

  

We’re backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Meritech, First Round, General Catalyst, Elad Gil, and others.


**Role Overview**
=================


The opportunities that matter most are often the hardest to get in front of. As our Field Marketing Manager, you'll work side by side with Sales to bring field programs to life across segments and help execute account\-based marketing (ABM) plays for our most important accounts. This is a hands\-on role for someone early in their career who's eager to learn fast, get creative, and see their work directly open doors and move deals forward.


You'll get real ownership from day one, plus coaching and room to grow. As our West Coast presence expands, so will your scope, budget, and responsibility.

**Who You Are**
===============

* **Creative and curious.** You see an opening where others see a closed door, and you're always looking for a fresh angle to reach the accounts that matter.
* **Not afraid to try new things.** You'd rather test something bold than default to "the way it's always been done" \- and you learn quickly from what works and what doesn't.
* **A doer.** You're happy to roll up your sleeves: pulling a report, coordinating with a venue, prepping event logistics, or dreaming up an eye\-catching way to grab a prospect's attention.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Help plan and run field marketing experiences \- regional dinners, happy hours, hackathons, and other creative moments \- that connect to active opportunities and target accounts.
* Support ABM programs for key accounts across channels: direct mail, events, digital, gifting, and content.
* Own the logistics and execution of field events end to end: venues, vendors, invites, registration, on\-site coordination, and follow\-up.
* Partner with Sales to understand territory priorities and account dynamics, and make sure every program ties back to pipeline.
* Track program impact \- account engagement, attendance, pilots started, and pipeline influenced \- and share what you're learning.
* Bring ideas to the table. Test new tactics, push boundaries, and help us stand out.

**What You'll Need**
====================

* 1\-2 years of experience in field, event, growth, or ABM marketing (internships and adjacent roles count).
* Familiarity with, or eagerness to quickly learn, tools like Salesforce, HubSpot (or similar), and intent platforms (6sense, Demandbase, or similar).
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail \- you can juggle multiple events and deadlines without dropping the ball.
* Comfort with data: you can pull basic reports, read metrics, and use them to make decisions.
* A collaborative style that earns trust with Sales and marketing teammates quickly.
* Comfortable moving fast, experimenting, and adjusting in real time.
* A creative thinker who can turn a rough goal into a concrete plan and follow through on execution.
* Comfortable with roughly 25% travel, up to 50% seasonally.

**Nice to Have**
================

* Exposure to marketing toward IT, Engineering, or Security audiences.
* Experience supporting events or campaigns in a B2B or startup environment.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Impact**: Be a key player in shaping the success of our product and company.
* **Growth**: Build a fundamentally new AI product offering with the support of our experienced team and investors. Grow rapidly with the company.
* **Culture**: Join a culture that values innovation, ownership, accountability, and fun.


Compensation Range: $125K \- $185K

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**



At Litify, we're powering a new era for the legal industry. Since our founding in 2016, we've helped law firms and corporate legal departments turn operations into impact through our leading AI\-native Platform of Action.



Over 55K legal professionals and 450\+ enterprise clients across plaintiff, insurance defense, immigration, and the Fortune 500 trust Litify to combine cloud\-based technology, configurable AI\-native workflows, agentic AI, and powerful business analytics into one open ecosystem that moves legal teams from systems of record to systems of action.



Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and recognized as an Inc. 5000 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 fastest\-growing private company, Litify is at the center of legal innovation. Headquartered in New York, we're building the last legal platform our customers will ever need.


**About the Role**



Events and field programs are one of our biggest pipeline drivers and some of our most powerful brand moments. We want to grow both – more cities, more formats, more ways to get in front of our audience, show up as Litify, and grow the business. We're looking for a Field Marketing Manager who can take a set of field programs and own them – from strategy and planning through execution and follow\-up – and make sure every event looks, feels, and performs like Litify.



You'll work closely with our Senior Field Marketing Manager who leads our events function, and partner with Sales, Customer Success, and the rest of Marketing to put Litify in front of the right audiences. This role fits someone who doesn't need a playbook handed to them – you'll help shape it, run it, and make it better each time.


**What You'll Do:**


* **Plan and run Litify\-hosted field events:** executive dinners, roundtables, happy hours, workshops, and regional roadshows from ideation to execution, with a clear plan for what success looks like
* **Organize and lead trade shows and industry conferences:** from choosing the right activations and sponsorships to booth strategy, the hosted events around each show, and on\-site meetings, making sure we maximize our presence and ROI
* **Treat every event as a brand activation:** partner with our creative team to bring the Litify brand to life, from booth design and on\-site experience to content, giveaways, and every attendee touchpoint
* **Own your program calendar end to end:** budget, venues, vendors, logistics, invites, promotion, on\-site execution, and post\-event follow\-up, including setting targets and measuring business impact
* **Partner closely with Sales on events:** picking the right target markets and accounts, identifying the audience, driving attendance, and turning events into pipeline
* **Support partner and customer events as part of our broader brand and GTM strategy:** building activations that grow these relationships, deliver a great brand experience, and help expand our book of business
* **Track and report on what's working:** attendance, pipeline generated and influenced, and ROI\- and use it to shape what comes next
* **Collaborate with the full marketing team** on pre\- and post\-event strategy, data and analysis, and design, while making sure everything is tracked
* **Travel to events as needed** (roughly 25–30%)


**What You Bring:**


* **3–5 years** **of field or event marketing experience**, ideally in B2B SaaS
* **A track record of owning programs end to end,** not just executing someone else's plan
* **Highly organized, with excellent project management:** you can juggle multiple events, budgets, and deadlines without dropping anything, and you know how to prioritize based on impact and timing
* **A business\-first mindset:** you start with the outcome, design the strategy and experience to deliver it, and always push for what moves the business forward
* **Comfort working with Sales and senior stakeholders**, and confidence in front of customers and executives
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce and event or marketing automation tools (Splash a plus)
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment where priorities can shift
* **Autonomous, driven, and collaborative:** you see what needs to happen, take ownership, and bring people along


**Nice to Have:**


* A strong eye for brand and design – you know what makes an event feel premium and memorable
* Experience marketing to legal, professional services, or enterprise audiences
* Customer marketing or community experience
* Experience with executive\-level events (GCs, managing partners, C\-suite)


**Disclosure:**  

This job is fully remote, with the exception of employees living in New York City and New Jersey**.** Our NYC/NJ employees adhere to our hybrid schedule, which involves working in our Manhattan office 6 days a month.



The estimated base salary pay range for this role is $115,000\-$125,000\. You will also be offered a bonus and benefits.



Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide.



Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skill set, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.

Clinical Research Coordinator I will oversee multiple clinical trials, investigator\-initiated studies, and quality improvement projects within the department of Neurology, serving as a point person for patients, their family members and the clinical study team. The position consists of working with various departments across the hospital, including forging new partnerships with departments to ensure completion of trial\-related activities. The clinical research coordinator I will direct participants and study team members to adhere to the study protocol and rules and regulations as governed by regulatory bodies including Institutional Review Boards and the FDA.
  

  

**Under general supervision duties will include:**  

* Directing seamless flow of daily trial\-related activities, recruitment and clinical assessments of the study subjects
* Directing strict adherence to the study protocols, as well as sponsor, FDA and other regulatory authority requirements.
* Designs and implements workflows for clinical trial, including reminders/updates to the clinical team
* Coordinating team members to complete both clinical and non\-clinical assessments per protocol. This includes developing workflow for patient care such as assigning secretaries to schedule patients, developing workflow with ancillary departments (such as radiology, advanced imaging, pathology, pharmacy), and assigning appropriate clinical team members such as doctors to complete clinical tasks such as reviewing adverse events versus assigning non\-clinical team members to complete non clinical tasks such as administering questionnaires to a patient.
* Executing IRB submissions (event reporting, study status change etc.)
* Executing patient billing in multiple databases including the patient's electronic medical record.
* Developing action plans for ensuring all study tasks are completed as required per the protocol and developing subsequent corrective action plans if any errors are made.

The Clinical Research Coordinator I will be trained to be highly specialized in clinical trials assigned to them. The Clinical Research Coordinator I is expected to be able to manage clinical trial projects independently after sufficient training is completed
  

  

**Essential Functions*** Escalates issues related to clinical trial conduct to PI and senior research staff.
* Assigns training to the PI and other research team members for protocol amendments, and any other study required training.
* Screens and consents patients and ensures the scheduling and completion of assessments for ongoing study visits as dictated by the protocol
* Collects required data and imaging and ensures data entry into EDCs/Databases and image upload to imaging portals.
* Develops and executes multifaceted recruitment strategies by blending creative patient outreach with technical workflow integration and cross\-departmental partnerships to optimize subject identification and enrollment.
* Oversees the quality of data provided to sponsor, escalates quality issues to the site manager.
* Maintains accurate records of study participants while safeguarding the confidentiality of subjects, as necessary.
* Maintains essential documents per FDA, Regulatory bodies, and sponsor requirements in the Regulatory Binder. This includes preparation of essential documents for the assigned clinical study
* Provides ready access to patient binders and regulatory binders to the PI, Sponsor and/or Regulatory Authorities for assigned clinical trials.
* Coordinates and carries out monitoring visits and audits for assigned clinical trial.
* Collaborates with appropriate institutional review board to ensure approval of the clinical trial (renewal), approval of study documents (renewal, modification, notification) and personnel.
* Assists management with collection of updated essential documents and certifications for site personnel and sends these to sponsor as requested.
* Participates in Site Initiation Visit.
* Processes, packages, stores and ships clinical specimens as required by the protocol.
* Responsible for device accountability, ordering and storage of investigational products and/or lab kits.
Performs other duties as assigned dependent on the nature of the clinical trial.  
* 

  

**Qualifications**

* BS Required
* OHS Annual Assessment Required
* OHS Fit Test Required
* CITI Good Clinical Practice Certification, CITI Research with Biomedical Drugs and Devices Certification, CITI Dangerous Goods and Biospecimen Handling Certification.
  

Experience in clinical research ,clinical trials and/or any medical related profession. Preferred

The position will be primarily based at the Hutch campus, with occasional travel to the Moses campus and other Montefiore locations as needed.

**Marketing Assistant**

  

Founded in 2008, Tutu School is a quaint and whimsical collection of boutique ballet schools designed to foster creativity and joy while encouraging tiny dancers to fully exercise their imagination as well as bodies. With over 100 locations across the U.S. and Canada, Tutu School provides an imaginative curriculum that celebrates the magic of childhood and builds confidence through movement.  

We are Tutu Collective Inc., a proud multi\-unit franchisee of Tutu School. We currently operate 11 Tutu School locations across California, New York and Connecticut. We are hiring for a Marketing Assistant. This position will report directly to the Director of Business Operations.  

**Job Summary**

  

We are looking for a Marketing Assistant who thinks like a marketer and sells like a relationship builder. This role will support local marketing efforts across our regions with a strong focus on events, partnerships, community outreach, and lead generation.  

The goal of this position is not simply to create awareness, but to turn that awareness into action: new families discovering our brand, attending a trial class, and ultimately becoming members of our community.

  

You will be responsible for the full cycle of event and partnership planning, from identifying opportunities and pitching partners to preparing for events, coordinating staffing and logistics, communicating with partners, and following up afterward. You will often be the first interaction a business, organization, influencer, or community partner has with our brand, so professionalism, confidence, and strong communication are essential.

  

This is a highly collaborative role that works closely with our Director of Business Operations, Regional Directors, Social Media Coordinator, Marketing Coordinators, and teaching teams across multiple markets.
  

**Responsibilities**
**Event \& Partnership Marketing**
* Identify and pursue local events, partnership, sponsorship, and community marketing opportunities across our regions.
* Own the full event lifecycle, including research, outreach, pitching, preparation, staffing, execution, communication, and follow\-up.
* Confidently pitch partnerships through email, phone calls, video calls, and in\-person conversations.
* Build and maintain relationships with local businesses, organizations, schools, family\-focused brands, influencers, and community groups.
* Coordinate event logistics, materials, staffing, schedules, promotional assets, and on\-site needs.
* Represent the brand professionally at community events and partnership activations.
* Follow up with event attendees and leads with the goal of driving trial classes, studio visits, and memberships.
* Track partnership and event results and identify opportunities to improve future activations.

**Local Marketing \& Lead Generation**
* Support organic marketing initiatives designed to increase local brand awareness and drive new customer acquisition.
* Help develop creative ways to bring new families into our studios and communities.
* Support promotional campaigns, local outreach, community initiatives, and grassroots marketing efforts.
* Assist with influencer partnerships, collaborations, and local creator activations.
* Develop relationships that create ongoing referral and lead\-generation opportunities.

**Content \& Social Support**
* Work closely with the Social Media Coordinator to support content creation for events, partnerships, and local marketing initiatives.
* Assist with creating simple graphics, promotional materials, Reels, and other marketing content.
* Help capture content at events and partnership activations when needed.
* Maintain brand consistency across communications and marketing materials.
* Canva and Asana experience is a plus.

**Paid Marketing Support**
* While this role is primarily focused on organic and local marketing, you should be comfortable working alongside paid marketing efforts.
* Support paid social, boosted content, and other digital campaigns as needed.
* Understand how organic partnerships and events can complement paid marketing efforts.

**What We're Looking For**
* Strong sales and relationship\-building skills with the confidence to initiate conversations and pitch opportunities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Professional, polished, and comfortable being the first point of contact with a potential partner.
* Experience working with influencers, partnerships, events, community marketing, or business development.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
* Able to manage multiple events, partnerships, and deadlines across different regions.
* Self\-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
* Comfortable communicating with a wide range of people through email, phone, video calls, and in person.
* Creative and resourceful with the ability to think of new ways to connect with local families and businesses.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, multi\-location environment.
* Strong follow\-through and a proactive approach to communication.
* Experience with Canva and Asana is a plus.
* Comfortable working with social media and creating basic marketing content.
* Experience with paid social or digital advertising is a plus but not required.

**What Success Looks Like**
Success in this role means creating meaningful local connections that turn into measurable business results. You will help us expand our presence in each market, build strong community partnerships, generate new leads, and ultimately drive more families into our studios through trial classes and memberships.  

We are looking for someone who doesn't wait for opportunities to come to them. You see a local business, event, influencer, or organization and think, \\"How could we partner?\\" Then you confidently reach out, build the relationship, and make it happen.

We strive to find loving homes for homeless and abandoned cats, dogs, guinea pigs and rabbits, both by adopting animals directly to the public and by partnering with more than 200 dedicated animal placement organizations (our New Hope partners). This position ensures that supplies, equipment, donations, and animal care essentials are accurately received, tracked, stored, distributed, and transported between ACC locations and external partners in a timely and organized manner.  

This is a hands\-on, field\-based position requiring frequent travel between ACC locations, headquarters, storage facilities, vendors, donors, and other designated locations. The Coordinator physically handles inventory and equipment, loads and unloads vehicles, and works in warehouse, storage, shelter, office, and outdoor environments. * Strong professional communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with internal departments, vendors, donors, carriers, and external partners.
* Ability to lift at least 50 lbs.

jobs.title: Apparel and Promotional Product Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
A to Z Media is seeking a detail\-oriented Apparel \& Promotional Product Development Coordinator. In this role, you will serve as the operational backbone of our merchandise department, executing and tracking product development, logistics, and vendor coordination for a diverse roster of music and brand clients.  

  

This role will focus on the seamless execution of merchandise programs, from initial start to final delivery. This role is ideal for a proactive, highly organized individual with a passion for music who thrives on cross\-functional collaboration, precise timeline management, and hands\-on problem solving.  

  

**What You’ll Do**  

  

**Product Development \& Timeline Tracking**  

  

\- Production Tracking \- manage the day\-to\-day product lifecycle, tracking items through the design, proofing, manufacturing, and final delivery stages  

\- Art Trafficking \- work closely with the internal Art Department to route design assets and proofs, ensuring client approvals are secured and accurate  

\- Schedule Maintenance \- maintain an up\-to\-date production calendar and generate weekly status reports to ensure all open projects stay on schedule  

\- Quality Control \- monitor pre\-production samples for quality issues, coordinate client approvals, and flag any discrepancies immediately  

  

**Vendor \& Sourcing Coordination**  

  

\- Vendor Liaison \- serve as a point of contact for our global vendor network to secure pricing, proofs, production timelines, and shipping methods  

\- Order Administration \- issue accurate Purchase Orders (POs) to vendors, confirm receipt, and monitor vendor portals for completion dates  

\- Sourcing Support \- assist in researching and vetting new vendors and manufacturers to expand apparel and promotional product options  

  

**Client Services \& Communication**  

  

\- Account Management \- maintain regular, clear communication (via email, Slack, Zoom, and phone) with clients, managers, and sales teams regarding job statuses  

\- Asset Creation \- assist in compiling internal pitch decks and monthly recaps showcasing newly developed products  

\- Issue Resolution \- act as a responsive point of contact for client claims, following established procedures to correct production or delivery errors swiftly  

  

**Logistics, Data, \& Order Administration**  

  

\- Database Accuracy \- maintain accurate and real\-time records of milestones, production notes, and shipping details within our custom database  

\- Financial Administration \- generate and issue accurate client invoices upon project completion; coordinate VAT and domestic sales tax billing with the finance team  

\- Inventory \& Warehouse Coordination \- liaise with the warehouse team to coordinate incoming shipments, pickups, physical inventory counts, and product reworks  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

\- Experience \- 2 \- 4 years of relevant experience in product coordination, apparel production, account \- management, or merchandise operations  

\- Industry Knowledge \- direct experience working within an apparel, promotional products, or music merchandise environment is highly preferred  

\- Project Management \- proven ability to handle multiple competing priorities simultaneously in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment  

\- Communication \- exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both business executives and creative artists/managers  

\- Adaptability \- high comfort level working in a dynamic environment, with a "can\-do" attitude and a knack for proactive problem\-solving  

  

**Key Skill Set**  

  

\- Extreme Attention to Detail \- inherent focus on follow\-through, database accuracy, and order precision  

\- Cross\-Functional Collaboration \- ability to act as a seamless bridge between sales, art, logistics, accounting, and external partners.  

\- Logistical Aptitude \- understanding of shipping, tracking, warehousing, and production workflows  

\- Creative Alignment \- a strong eye for product quality and design, combined with a genuine passion for music culture and artist branding.  

  

Founded in 1994, A to Z Media is a family\-owned company specializing in Vinyl, CD, DVD, Promotional Product and Apparel, and Manufacturing Services. For over 30 years, we have been committed to delivering exceptional customer service, high\-quality products, and competitive pricing for our global clientele. We work closely with clients to provide bespoke manufacturing solutions, including special printing, packaging, production, and logistical support. Our clients range from indie labels and branding agencies to distributors and Fortune 500 companies. At A to Z Media, we pride ourselves on being a true partner in bringing creative visions to life.  

  

Full\-Time, Onsite to Hybrid, $45,000 \- $65,000

jobs.description:
**Are you looking to Optimize your life? Start your exciting path to a rewarding career today!**

  

We are Optimum, a leader in the fast\-paced world of connectivity, and we're seeking driven and enthusiastic professionals to join our team, empower lives, fuel businesses, and drive innovation. Connectivity is now longer a luxury, but a necessity. A career at Optimum means you'll be enabling progress and enhancing lives by providing reliable, high\-speed connectivity solutions that keep the world connected. Our successes, now and in the future, are powered by our amazing product, a commitment to our people and culture, and the connections we make in our communities.

  

If you are resourceful, collaborative, and passionate about delivering consistent excellence, Optimum is for you!


**Job Summary**
---------------



As a Community Account Manager, you will be assigned a portfolio of muti\-dwelling unit properties. The primary responsibility as CAM, is to grow and maintain market share by selling new movers, win\-back customers, and upgrade existing customers to maximize monthly recurring revenue. Additionally, our CAM, will develop and manage the onsite relationship with the leasing staff, to ensure we are maximizing the terms of our marketing agreement, driving growth through educating staff and residents about the value of our products and reliability of our service, while positioning Optimum favorably against competitors and for contract renewals. In this role, you will be assigned new properties ensuring we maximize MDU new build customer penetration by working with onsite sales personnel and internal field operations to be “first to the door”.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Consistent achievement of monthly sales, revenue quotas and key performance indicators.
* Coordinate marketing events and cultivate relationships with sales, leasing staff and HOA's representing our brand, products while providing service excellence.
* Conduct site and virtual visits with property staff, updating and replenishing sales collateral, and educating leasing staff about new and existing product offers and the value of the optimum brand.
* Schedule quarterly/semi\-annual reviews with property staff to “walk” the property, understand business trends and share property performance against established targets.
* Act as a liaison between property management and our internal Technical Operations, Construction Department and Sales Support to address service issues that impacts our ability to deliver on\-time and exceptional service.
* Timely tracking and reporting of all sales, events, visits, and property escalations.
* Act as a point of contact with Bulk Property management staff, coordinating new customer onboarding and de\-bulk events.
* All other duties assigned by your supervisor.
**Qualifications**
------------------


* 5\+ years related experience.
* Ability to travel up to 75%
* Strong communication skills are a must.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Office Suite programs is required.
* Business Development experience with emphasis on new customer acquisition and relationship management.
* Must be self\-motivated and able to work independently.
* Computer skills, including Windows\-based applications, and the ability to work within Salesforce and sales order entry and CRM platforms.
* Strong people and relationship management skills.
* Must possess and maintain a valid driver’s license in good standing within the state of current residence.

Demand for bullet\-resistant glass and architectural security systems is at an all\-time high. As a fast\-growing industry leader, we deliver custom, life\-saving protection solutions \- protecting people and property across commercial facilities, schools, government buildings, and corporate campuses nationwide.

***We are looking for an ambitious, creative sales professional to live in and run our Northeast Territory.*** This is a high\-autonomy field position where you own your territory like your own business, build major commercial relationships, and directly drive company growth.

**Why Sales Professionals Choose This Role**

* Represent the company at key industry events and trade associations, including AIA and BOMA.

**What Makes YOU a Great Fit**

* Strong consultative selling skills—you know how to ask diagnostic questions, listen to client needs, and present tailored solutions.
