jobs.title: CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Summary**



The CRM \& Lifecycle Marketing Coordinator will keep Topstep's CRM instance clean, organized, and running smoothly. This role owns the day\-to\-day operational health of the CRM: database hygiene, subscription management, folder and file organization, campaign setup and tracking, and QA, and will provide hands\-on execution support for lifecycle and evergreen email programs.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-obsessed, and comfortable owning recurring, process\-driven work. You're curious about marketing technology and enjoy exploring and standing up new tools, and you take pride in a well\-maintained system that others can rely on. You will work closely with the Sr. Lifecycle \& CRM Marketing Lead and collaborate with Creative and QA partners to keep lifecycle communications running without a hitch


**Key Responsibilities**


**CRM Platform \& Database Management**


* Keep contact lists clean and healthy: merge duplicate records, process unsubscribes/unbounce requests, and audit subscription and preference center settings to ensure they work as intended.
* Maintain the folder structures and naming conventions for content, creative, and file assets within HubSpot so teams can find what they need.
* Explore and evaluate new HubSpot tools and features as they roll out (e.g., AI features, surveys, HubDB, ASO) and lead hands\-on setup and configuration.
* Serve as the go\-to owner for day\-to\-day CRM hygiene and platform upkeep.


**Campaign \& Lifecycle Execution Support**


* Support lifecycle and evergreen email programs by monitoring for breaks or errors, tracking send volume, and flagging opportunities for improvement.
* Set up and configure campaigns in the CRM to ensure proper tracking and attribution of email performance.
* Partner with QA teams to run pre\-send testing (rendering, links, personalization tokens, deliverability) across lifecycle and campaign emails.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Work closely with Engineering, Marketing Operations and Analytics teams.
* Coordinate with Creative and Brand partners on asset intake, organization, and file handoffs.
* Support QA and testing partners to ensure every send meets quality standards before launch.


**Required Qualifications and Key Competencies**


* 3\+ years of experience in email marketing operations, CRM administration, or marketing operations.
* Highly detail\-oriented and organized, with a strong sense of ownership over recurring, process\-driven work.
* Experience with database hygiene practices such as deduplication, list segmentation, and subscription/preference management.
* Familiarity with QA and testing processes for email campaigns.
* Basic email building and scheduling experience.
* Experience in Google slides for process document creation.
* Must have basic HTML knowledge (CSS and Handlebar (Or equivalent) is a plus).
* Curiosity and comfort exploring and adopting new marketing technology and tools.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate cross\-functionally with Creative, QA, and Marketing partners.


**Preferred Qualifications and Key Competencies**


* Hands\-on HubSpot experience.


**Company Culture \& Perks**


* Topstep is an engaging working environment which ranges from fully remote to hybrid. We foster a culture of collaboration with cameras on during meetings and a robust Slack environment for communication.
* Seven Company\-paid Holidays and generous Family Leave. Paid time off is front\-loaded.
* Competitive 401(k) matching, health, dental, and vision insurance is offered for full time employees.
* Vacations are encouraged with a bonus for taking 5 consecutive days. Employee referrals are bonused. Topstep offers a food and groceries budget and contributes towards health and wellness.


**New Hire Base Salary Range**


* $33\.65 \- $40\.87 hourly.
* Bonus: This position is eligible for a performance\-based bonus as provided by the plan terms and governing documents.
* The compensation offered will take into account internal compensation structure and may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors.


**Equal Opportunity Employer**

All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

jobs.title: Production Coordinator - Thinkingbox
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**  

Hi! We’re Thinkingbox, the brief to built agency. Creating innovative digital, experiential, social, and content, we partner with leading brands across industries like sports, gaming, entertainment, and technology. We believe the hands that carefully craft the work should belong to the minds that dreamed it. So while others pass the buck, we’re already building. Because our thinkers are also the makers. Culture is at the heart of who we are, and our offices are hubs of natural collaboration. From hanging out with our office dogs to enjoying Thursday happy hours, we keep our work environment vibrant, welcoming, and fun. Each year, we also encourage our people to spend a month exploring the world, whether that means working from another office or even from the beaches of Mexico, to expand their perspectives and bring fresh inspiration back to the team.


**The Opportunity**  

As a Production Coordinator, you will support the planning and execution of integrated projects across experiential, content, social, and digital. You will work closely with Producers, Project Managers, Creative teams, and external partners to help keep projects running smoothly from kickoff through delivery.



This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast paced agency environment, enjoys problem solving, and is eager to grow their production career across multiple disciplines.



### **What You’ll Be Doing**

* Support Producers and Project Managers on experiential, content, strategy, social, and digital projects
* Assist with project scheduling, timelines, and production calendars
* Help coordinate internal teams, freelancers, vendors, and external partners
* Track project deliverables, assets, and approvals
* Prepare call sheets, production documents, and status updates
* Assist with budgets, purchase orders, invoices, and expense tracking
* Help ensure projects stay on scope, schedule, and budget
* Support on set or on site production as needed
* Maintain clear and consistent communication across teams

### **What You'll Bring**

* 1 to 3 years of experience in production coordination, project coordination, or a related role, ideally within an agency or production environment
* Experience or strong interest in experiential, content, social, and digital production
* Exceptional organizational and time management skills
* Strong attention to detail and follow through
* Clear written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once in a fast paced environment
* Comfortable working with tools such as Google Workspace, Slack, and project management platforms
* A collaborative, proactive, and solutions oriented mindset

### **Bonus Points!**

* Experience supporting live events, activations, or on site productions
* Experience in the hospitality/service industry
* On set experience
* Familiarity with content production workflows including video, photography, and social
* Basic understanding of budgets and production finance
* Experience working with external vendors and freelancers

### **Additional Info**

* Monday \- Thursday in office (Fridays are remote optional)
* Flexible time off, including paid vacation and sick days
* Consistent culture and team\-building events
* Employee recognition and incentive programs
* Seasonal celebrations and gatherings throughout the year
* Office lunches
* Branded company swag
* Access to industry events, learning opportunities, and non\-profit outreaches
* Dog\-friendly offices
* Unlimited coffee, drinks, and snacks
* Flex work and travel options
* Comprehensive extended health benefits
* 401k matching

Placement in the salary range will be based on factors such as internal equity, candidate experience, skills, and qualifications relevant to the role. If your compensation expectations fall outside of this range, we still welcome your application.
**Equal Opportunity**  

At Thinkingbox, we’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to thrive. We believe that diversity is our creative strength – it's the range of perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds that fuels our best ideas and most innovative solutions. We welcome and encourage applicants of all races, ethnicities, genders, identities, abilities, ages, sexual orientations, and backgrounds to apply. Your voice matters here.


**To Apply**

**Job Summary:**


The Recruiting Coordinator supports the Firm’s recruiting and onboarding activities for business professionals by coordinating interviews, maintaining accurate candidate and recruiting data, communicating with candidates and internal stakeholders, and assisting with orientation and new\-hire integration. The position partners closely with the Recruiting Manager and Human Resources team to deliver a professional, responsive, and consistent candidate and new\-hire experience. Success in this role requires strong organization, sound judgement, attention to detail, discretion, and the ability to manage multiple time\-sensitive priorities independently.

 **Essential Duties**

* Coordinate interviews, including calendars, travel, meeting rooms, virtual meeting technology, catering, and candidate arrival logistics
* Communicate with candidates throughout the recruiting process and provide timely, professional follow\-up
* Gather and track interview feedback
* Maintain accurate and complete candidate information in the applicant tracking system
* Prepare recurring and ad hoc reports for the HR team and Firm leadership
* Help develop and maintain recruiting relationships with organizations in our markets
* Facilitate and conduct new team member orientations
* Participate in screening interviews
* Coordinate new hire gifts
* Process invoices and expense reports
* Maintain internal resources such as recruiting intranet page, IceLearn, HRIS system and any future programs adopted by the team
* Initiate background checks and communicate completed results to the Recruiting Manager
* Assist with new position intake and calibration meetings
* Provide excellent customer service to internal clients, prospective candidates, and other professionals throughout the Firm in responding to questions and concerns regarding the Team’s activities
* Develop proficiency in technologies adopted now or in the future

* Provide back\-up support and assist with research and special projects \=

* High school diploma required; Bachelor’s degree preferred

* Proactive approach to identifying opportunities for process improvement
* Committed to professional growth and continuous learning
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate records and data
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to research and analyze various types of data
* Strong interpersonal skills to communicate with a diverse group of people

* Strong Microsoft Word and Excel skills and ability to learn other computer programs quickly

**Company Overview:**



Everything we do is for educators. We're partnering with them to advance a bold vision for education that boosts district performance and student success. At Follett Software, we empower educators across roles with technology that streamlines processes and manages information and resources to improve their schools, increase student success, and drive the future of education. We believe that by empowering educators to amplify their impact on students' lives, we can change the world. Our goal and mission is to drive the future of education. We are inspired by educators to deliver transformative technology. Our innovative, connected solutions simplify challenges and offer a seamless and intuitive experience.

  



**POSITION SUMMARY**

  


The Inside Sales Account Executive (Territory\- LA, MO) position optimizes inbound/outbound telephone, virtual meetings/presentations, and e\-mail contact to sell our ever\-growing technology solutions. Each Inside AE is accountable for individual monthly, quarterly, and annual quotas, strategically targeting both recurring and one\-time revenue goals set by Follett Software. Join the industry's most respected and forward\-thinking SaaS leader within the booming EdTech market. As we experience unprecedented growth, we seek seasoned sales professionals with proven SaaS expertise to be integral members of our high\-performing sales team.

  


**POSITION SCOPE**

  


**Drive Sales Growth:**


* Generate new business and expand existing accounts within an assigned territory, focusing on software and solution\-based sales.
* Own the full sales cycle from prospecting through close, consistently achieving or exceeding quota targets.


**Sales Execution \& Activity Management:**


* Effectively manage daily and weekly activities (e.g., call blocks, outreach cadence) to drive pipeline growth and deal progression.
* Meet or exceed defined activity metrics and performance KPIs set by sales leadership.
* Maintain accurate and consistent sales forecasts (weekly, monthly, quarterly) to support business planning.

* Leverage Salesforce and sales enablement tools (e.g., Highspot, Consensus) to manage pipeline, track performance, and improve sales efficiency.

* Conduct virtual discovery calls, product demonstrations, and tailored presentations that align solutions to customer needs.
* Apply a consultative sales approach to identify customer challenges and position appropriate solutions.
* Identify and drive upsell and cross\-sell opportunities within existing accounts.


**Territory \& Pipeline Development:**


* Build and execute a strategic territory plan focused on target accounts, industries, and buyer personas.
* Continuously develop and maintain a healthy pipeline by prioritizing high\-value opportunities.


**Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement:**


* Partner cross\-functionally with marketing, customer success, and product teams to enhance the customer experience and drive revenue growth.
* Continuously refine sales strategies based on feedback, data insights, and market trends.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage, influence, and build trust with a variety of stakeholders and buyer personas.
* Proven ability to conduct discovery, identify customer pain points, and position solutions through a consultative sales approach.

* Accelerate customer adoption of Google Cloud by leading the implementation journey. Provide technical guidance and manage timelines, milestones, migration goal and business transformation strategies.

* Develop relationships with stakeholders to understand customer’s business, develop strategic roadmaps, and lead quarterly business reviews and executive sessions to better understand business and technical needs.

* Develop best practices and assets based on learnings from customer engagements to support initiatives to scale through partners and accelerate Google Cloud adoption.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Pet Specialty
jobs.description:
**Key Account Manager – Pet Specialty**  

**Location:** Oak Brook, IL (In\-Office)  

**Reports to:** Sr. Sales Manager  

**Category Focus:** Pet Specialty  

  

**About Inaba Foods (USA) Inc.**  

Inaba Foods is a manufacturer of premium pet food, treats, toppers, and complements, deeply rooted in a family tradition of excellence that spans generations. Since 1958, pet parents have trusted Inaba to deliver products that are human\-grade, nutrient\-rich, and designed to bring joy to pets.  

  

Today, Inaba is the most popular brand of premium cat and dog dinners and treats in Japan, with growing distribution throughout the United States and globally. Inaba Foods (USA) Inc. continues to expand its footprint, invest in talent, and build long\-term partnerships across the pet industry, supported by the stability and vision of our Japanese parent company.  

  

**Position Summary**  

Inaba Foods (USA) Inc. is seeking a Key Account Manager – Pet to develop and manage strategic relationships at the headquarters and regional level with national and regional retailers, as well as distributors, within the Pet Specialty channel. This role is responsible for driving growth, expanding distribution, and strengthening long\-term partnerships while collaborating closely with internal teams to execute sales strategies.  

  

This is a full\-time, in\-office position based in Oak Brook, IL, as required by company leadership.  

  

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

* Grow distribution and sales volume within assigned Pet Specialty accounts
* Strengthen distributor relationships to expand market presence and execution
* Become a trusted partner to customers through strategic planning and consistent engagement
* Contribute to category growth through promotions, pricing strategies, and market insights
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to support forecasting, production planning, and account strategy

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers and distributors, nurturing existing business and driving incremental growth
* Analyze historical and current purchase order data to project sales, assess profitability, and identify growth opportunities
* Lead and participate in customer business reviews and market presentations
* Maintain regular engagement with accounts to ensure customer needs are met or exceeded
* Execute promotional strategies and programs to drive volume and brand visibility
* Provide sales forecasts and input for production and demand planning
* Collaborate with executive leadership on pricing, promotions, quotes, and account strategies
* Resolve customer issues related to product, service, or sales execution
* Monitor competitive activity, market trends, and merchandising techniques
* Manage expenses in alignment with budgeted guidelines
* Demonstrate a growth\-oriented, proactive sales approach focused on building and expanding strategic relationships
* Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and ethical standards while representing Inaba in a professional manner
* Perform additional duties as assigned

 **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, or a related field
* 3\-7 years of experience in sales within Pet Specialty, Food \& Beverage, or adjacent CPG categories
* Experience calling on headquarters, regional offices, and/or managing distributor relationships
* Strong ability to analyze trends, data, and sales performance metrics
* Proficiency in creating compelling PowerPoint sales presentations
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and customer service skills
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities
* Experience working cross\-functionally with internal teams and external partners
* Ability to travel locally or regionally as needed, including time spent in the field
* Valid driver’s license with a safe driving record, in accordance with company policy
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite or related software

  

  

**Why Join Inaba Foods**

* Growing U.S. business with expanding distribution and increasing market presence
* Long\-term stability and leadership from a well\-established Japanese parent company
* Opportunity to manage meaningful accounts and influence growth strategy
* Collaborative, professional environment with a strong brand reputation

  

Inaba Foods is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment laws, including California’s Fair Employment and Housing Act.  

  

This employer participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

jobs.title: Named Regional Account Manager
jobs.description:
The Named Regional Account Manager (RAM) is an exciting new role within the Fortinet sales organization that is focused on an important subset of the Mid\-Market segment. The RAM is a field sales position responsible for a specific set of Mid\-Market accounts while also having shared responsibility for all Mid\-Market business within their territory. The ideal candidate will have previous field sales experience in the B2B technology space. The RAM will create and execute an account plan from prospecting to building and maintaining a constant revenue pipeline. Fortinet will provide initial onboarding education to begin your career. Success in the RAM role provides many options in the overall career path at Fortinet.  



**Responsibilities:**

* Meet or exceed all assigned quotas and targets while forecasting weekly, monthly and quarterly revenues for the assigned account set and overall territory

* Follow up on inbound, web and corporate event leads
* Accept inbound and perform outbound prospecting activities to identify new sales opportunities.
* Meet and exceed the sales activity metrics designed to make you productive and successful.
* Lead customer presentation and demos via online tools (GO TO MEETING)
* Perform ongoing analysis and report on opportunities that are supported
* Act as a liaison between partner, customers, and appropriate Fortinet team members

Execute the role with the utmost professionalism and in a way that aligns to Fortinet’s core values  
* 

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree
* Coachable and flexible
* 1\+ years of field sales experience in the B2B technology space
* Working knowledge of the businesses and partners in the local territory
* Ability to run productive customer\-facing and partner\-facing meetings while providing timely and relevant written follow up
* A proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales quotas and targets
* Understanding of the sales cycle in conjunction with business processes internally and externally
* Ability to manage and drive sales cycles from start to finish, which includes experience with managing and forecasting individual quota
* Self\-driven and able to manage a diverse, high volume workload
* Ability to quickly build productive relationships in a fast\-paced, high\-performance environment
* Be computer savvy
* Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills
* Well organized with effective time and activity management skills
* Ability to apply entrepreneurial strengths in a driven, forward\-thinking manner
* Ability to close business while achieving a high level of customer and partner satisfaction
* Execute the role with the utmost professionalism and in a way that aligns to Fortinet’s core values
The Regional Account Manager is required to spend more than 50% of their time outside of their office or home office engaged in selling, including travel as needed to make a sale.  
* 

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Public/private cloud experience is a plus
* Experience with multi\-tier distribution a plus.
* Experience in networking, security and/or public/private cloud a plus

jobs.title: Surety Account Manager III
jobs.description:
Posting Description: **Surety Account Manager III**

  

Are you a surety professional who thrives at the intersection of client service, underwriting strategy, and operational execution? Join a high\-performing team and take on a meaningful role managing and delivering surety bond solutions for many clients!

  

This hybrid position requires working 3 days a week from an Aon office.

 **Aon is in the business of better decisions**


At Aon, we build decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

  

As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

 **What the day will look like**


Provides analytical and operational services for a portfolio of surety bond clients, with an emphasis on accuracy, client interaction, underwriting pricing rigor \& negotiation, and execution quality. Partners closely with clients to facilitate timely issuance of surety obligations. Reports to the regional Surety Operations leader. (Director or Team Lead).

* Operates with a high degree of autonomy and judgment across complex or strategically significant accounts and in dealing with markets.
* Takes primary accountability for handling selected key accounts, including coordination of large bond programs and sophisticated underwriting submissions.
* Possesses strong, in\-depth knowledge of surety bonds, including contract and commercial surety, indemnity structures, and market dynamics.
* Serves as a technical lead within the team; assists in training, mentoring, and developing internal team, and contributes to improvement in execution initiatives.
* Collaborates daily with carriers on complex needs. Prepares and processes a broad range of surety instruments, including but not limited to bid, final, miscellaneous, and court bonds, ensuring alignment with underwriting parameters and client requirements.
* Collaborates daily with clients on complex needs. Completes Consents of Surety, Prequalification Letters, Riders, and other client required obligations per State requirements. Determines appropriate documentation to finalize issuance, i.e. power\-of\-attorney, resident license, etc. with attention to contractual, legal, and financial implications.
* Prepares General Indemnity Agreements and bond applications, coordinating with and advising clients to obtain complete, accurate financial and corporate information for underwriting review – including any other nuanced client needs or requirements.
* Maintains and facilitates data integrity and enabling proactive management of bond programs in AonBondLink (ABL).
* Works closely with internal collaborators to build and maintain accurate, complete electronic bond files in AonBondLink (ABL). It also confirms and manages client financial and underwriting records while following internal controls and audit requirements to avoid E\&O.
* Manages countersignature requirements and related jurisdictional nuances to support compliant bond issuance across multiple states and territories.
* Provides technical surety guidance and support to non\-surety colleagues, helping interpret bond forms, indemnity requirements, and program structures for internal stakeholders.
* Coordinates receipt and organization of pertinent client related underwriting information (e.g., financial statements, work\-in\-progress schedules, bank information, organizational documents) to support timely carrier decisions.
* Verifies that all bonds are issued within established surety lines of credit and brokerage authority; assists in structuring and negotiating approvals for bond requests that exceed standard limits or fall outside delegated authority.

 **How this opportunity is different**


Unlike many surety operations roles focused mainly on transaction processing, this position combines technical surety expertise with client advisory duties and meaningful market involvement. You will work directly with complex bonding programs, underwriting negotiations, and carrier relationships while acting as a trusted resource for clients and internal colleagues. The role also allows for broader influence through mentoring, participation in operational improvement, and responsibility for critical compliance and underwriting workflows. For professionals wanting to move beyond administrative bond issuance and act as a strategic partner in the surety process, this is an outstanding chance to increase visibility, expand impact, and grow within a leading organization.

 **Skills and experience that will lead to success**

* Is able to effectively interpret a wide range of technical instructions and documentation involving abstract and concrete variables, including financial analyses, contractual provisions, and underwriting guidelines.
* Possesses experience or formal education in Risk Management, Insurance, and/or Surety, and applies this background to enhance client and market outcomes.
* Demonstrates strong organizational, time\-management, and multi\-tasking skills, consistently managing high\-volume and complex workloads.
* Maintains Notary Public designation.
* Maintains Power of Attorney appointments with major surety markets and is regarded as a trusted signatory.
* Maintains appropriate Producer license
* Is proficient in all required technology platforms, including AonBondLink, Bridge, and Outlook, and utilizes these systems to manage data, analyze bond portfolios, and support decision\-making.

  

Education and licensing requirements: A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred for this position. Maintain Notary Public designation and hold the appropriate Property and Casualty license.

jobs.description:

We are seeking a highly motivated and results\-driven Convenience Channel Sales Account Manager to join our sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales and growth within the convenience channel, managing key accounts, executing strategic sales plans, and building strong relationships with retailers and distributors. You will act as the primary point of contact for accounts within the convenience channel, ensuring product placement, competitive positioning, and effective category management and merchandising. jobs.title: Partner Success Manager- Account Growth & Inside Sales
jobs.description:
Partner Success Manager – Account Growth \& Inside Sales  


Community Tax is looking for a Partner Success Manager to manage, develop, and grow relationships with our referral partners.  


This is a relationship\-driven account management role with a consultative sales component. Our referral partners have already chosen to work with Community Tax, so you won't spend your day cold calling strangers looking for the next prospect.  


Instead, you'll help partners become successful with Community Tax—building relationships, increasing referral activity, solving problems, re\-engaging less\-active accounts, and identifying additional solutions that can provide value to their businesses.  


This isn't a traditional high\-pressure sales role—and it isn't a traditional customer service role.  


We're looking for someone in between: a relationship builder with commercial instincts.  


What You'll Do  


You'll manage an assigned portfolio of Community Tax referral partners and serve as their primary day\-to\-day point of contact.  


You'll:  


Onboard new partners and help them successfully make their first referral.  
Build strong relationships and understand each partner's business and referral needs.  
Conduct regular check\-ins and proactive account outreach.  
Monitor referral activity, engagement, and overall account health.  
Recognize when activity slows or changes, find out why, and work to re\-engage the partner.  
Identify opportunities to increase referrals and expand productive partner relationships.  
Answer questions, solve problems, and coordinate with internal teams when assistance is needed.  
Introduce additional Community Tax products and solutions when they can provide genuine value.  
Maintain accurate account activity, notes, and follow\-up within our CRM.  


The Person We're Looking For  


The strongest Partner Success Managers understand that relationship building and sales aren't competing responsibilities.  


You build trust, ask good questions, understand what a partner needs, recognize opportunities, recommend appropriate solutions, and aren't afraid to ask for the business when the solution makes sense.  


You don't need to be a hard\-closing, commission\-driven salesperson to succeed here. But you do need to be comfortable with sales, persuasion, business conversations, measurable goals, and being accountable for growth.  


You may be a strong fit if you:  


Build rapport and credibility naturally.  
Enjoy developing ongoing business relationships.  
Are proactive rather than waiting for someone to ask for help.  
Listen well and ask effective questions.  
Notice changes in account activity and want to understand why.  
Can recommend a solution without making the relationship feel transactional.  
Are comfortable discussing products, money, business needs, and opportunities.  
Can address questions or objections and confidently move a conversation toward action.  
Stay organized while managing multiple accounts and follow\-ups.  
Take ownership and follow through on commitments.  


Your previous title might be Account Manager, Inside Sales Representative, Customer Success Manager, Partner Success Manager, Relationship Manager, Business Development Representative, or something completely different.  


We're more interested in whether you've developed the right combination of relationship and commercial skills.  


Compensation \& Incentives  


Base Salary: $50,000  


In addition to base salary, Partner Success Managers are eligible for:  


10% – 20% annual performance bonus opportunity, paid quarterly based on applicable partner performance measures.  
CTAX Intelligence revenue incentive on qualifying revenue collected within onboarded and assigned accounts.  
Additional Phase One sales incentives during the March–May tax\-season sales assignment.  


Consultative Solution Sales  


As part of the role, you'll be trained to introduce, demonstrate, and sell CTAX Intelligence, our subscription\-based SaaS transcript solution designed specifically for our target market.  


This is consultative selling: understand the partner's business, identify a need, demonstrate the solution, answer questions, address objections, and confidently ask for the business when there's a good fit.  


The goal isn't to turn every conversation into a sales pitch. It's to know your partners well enough to recognize when Community Tax has something that can genuinely help them—and to be comfortable having that conversation.  


A Seasonal Change of Pace  


From approximately March through May, Partner Success Managers also help Community Tax's consumer sales organization manage increased tax\-season demand.  


You'll receive comprehensive Phase One tax resolution sales training and work with qualified prospective clients to understand their needs, explain our Phase One service, and help appropriate clients enroll.  


You'll also have an opportunity to earn additional sales incentives during this seasonal assignment.  


After tax season, your primary focus returns to your referral partner portfolio.  


Qualifications  


2\+ years of relevant experience in account management, inside sales, partner or customer success, relationship management, business development, or a comparable client\-facing role preferred.  
Strong relationship\-building, verbal, and written communication skills.  
Comfortable with consultative selling and persuasive business conversations.  
Strong organization, prioritization, and follow\-through.  
Ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities, and commitments.  
Comfortable using CRM technology, screen share demo/presentation technology and maintaining accurate account activity.  
Ability to recognize account trends, risks, and growth opportunities.  
Experience in tax services, financial services, SaaS, professional services, affiliate/referral programs, or another relationship\-driven business environment is helpful but not required.

jobs.description:
**Inside Sales Representative**
-------------------------------


**Location:** Aurora, IL, 60504
**Company Overview**
Since our doors opened in 1989, Reliable Medical has been committed to improving the lives of all who entrust us with their care and those who we entrust to provide it. We strive to be the premier provider of complex mobility solutions and other critical services for customers seeking compassionate care and optimal outcomes. Our mission is to improve the lives of those we serve by providing best in class service to customers, education, product expertise and dedicated partnership to clinicians, and development, career satisfaction and work\-life balance to our team members. We aspire to bring our mission to new communities and to reinvest our growth into improving lives, treating one another and our customers, like family.
**Job Description**
We are seeking a motivated and results driven Inside Sales Representative to join our team. As an Inside Sales Representative, you will play a key role in expanding our customer base and driving revenue growth by effectively promoting and selling our range of home medical equipment to healthcare providers, clinics, and individual customers. Your primary responsibilities will include proactively reaching out to prospective clients, providing product information, offering personalized solutions, and closing sales deals. This is an excellent opportunity for a talented individual with a passion for healthcare and sales to make a significant impact on our organization's success.



**Essential Functions**
* Sales Generation:
	+ Actively prospect, qualify, and generate new sales leads through outbound calls, emails, and other communication channels.
	+ Conduct thorough needs assessments to understand customer requirements and recommend appropriate home medical equipment solutions.
	+ Effectively communicate product features, benefits, and pricing information to prospective customers.
	+ Collaborate with the sales team to achieve sales targets and revenue objectives.
* Relationship Building:
	+ Build and maintain strong, long\-lasting relationships with existing and potential customers.
	+ Provide exceptional customer service by promptly responding to inquiries, resolving issues, and addressing concerns.
	+ Identify upselling and cross\-selling opportunities to maximize customer value and satisfaction.
	+ Stay updated on industry trends, competitor products, and market conditions to effectively position our offerings.
* Sales Process Management:
	+ Utilize CRM software to manage and track leads, sales activities, and customer interactions.
	+ Prepare and deliver persuasive sales presentations, quotes, and proposals.
	+ Negotiate and close sales deals while ensuring profitability and customer satisfaction.
	+ Collaborate with internal departments, including operations and logistics, to ensure smooth order processing and timely delivery of products.
* Product Knowledge and Training:
	+ Develop a comprehensive understanding of our home medical equipment product line.
	+ Stay informed about industry regulations, product updates, and technological advancements.
	+ Participate in training sessions and product demonstrations to enhance product knowledge and sales techniques.

**Qualifications and Requirements**
* High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor’s degree in business administration, Sales, or a related field is preferred.
* Previous experience in selling home medical equipment or healthcare\-related products is advantageous.
* Familiarity with medical terminology and basic understanding of insurance billing processes is a plus.
* Proven experience as an Inside Sales Representative or in a similar sales role.
* Strong track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.
* Knowledge of the home medical equipment industry, including products and market dynamics, is highly desirable.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage and build relationships with diverse customer groups.
* Strong negotiation and persuasive selling skills.
* Results\-oriented mindset with a focus on customer satisfaction.
* Excellent organizational and time management abilities.
* Proficiency in CRM software and MS Office Suite.

**Physical Requirements**
* Must be able to lift up to 30 pounds at times.
* Prolong periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

**Our Commitment To You**
* Comprehensive Health Coverage
* Generous Paid Time Off
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Retirement Savings Plan
* Wellness Programs
* Inclusive and Diverse Workplace
* Volunteer Opportunities
* Employee Recognition Programs

jobs.description:
**About Wonder**


Everything’s on the menu at Wonder. Except compromise.


Wonder is the mealtime platform built to feed every craving in one order. With Wonder, you can mix and match hundreds of dishes from 20\+ exclusive restaurants in a single order, so everyone gets exactly what they’re craving. Enjoy everything from tacos to Thai with $0 delivery fees, plus dine\-in or pick up at a Wonder location near you. Each dish is made to order on\-site by our culinary team and served hot.


Behind the scenes, Wonder owns and operates every step of the dining experience, from recipe development to the technology that powers our experience, allowing us to deliver quality, variety, and consistency at scale.

*Join us as we work to make great food more accessible.*

new_jobs.title: Project Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
The Project Operations Coordinator plays a crucial role in ensuring the smooth and efficient execution of project\-related sales orders and logistics. This position is responsible for managing the entire sales order lifecycle, from entry and revision in the ERP system to shipment coordination, and return material authorization (RMA) processing. The Project Operations Coordinator collaborates closely with internal teams, including Sales, Planning, Engineering, Projects, Controls, and Warehouse, as well as external customers and logistics providers, to ensure timely delivery and customer satisfaction. This role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and excellent communication abilities.

  

  

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  

  

Sales Order Management:


Accurately enter sales orders into the ERP system and submit them for approval.


Manage and process sales order revisions and updates as needed.


Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date sales order data within the ERP system.

  

  

Shipping and Logistics Coordination:


Oversee and track past due shipments, proactively addressing any potential delays.


Create shipping documents and manage the shipping process.


Contact customers to inform them of parts readiness for pickup or shipment.


Generate reports for new shipments to track progress and identify potential issues.


Coordinate crating requests with external vendors.


Verify weights and dimensions with the warehouse team to ensure accurate packing lists and commercial invoices.


Edit and finalize packing lists and commercial invoices.

  

  

Compliance and Documentation:


Conduct End\-User Certificate (EUC) checks for internal company orders to ensure compliance with export regulations.

  

  

Customer and Vendor Communication:


Serve as a primary point of contact for customers and logistics companies, providing timely updates and resolving any inquiries or issues.

  

  

Return Material Authorization (RMA) Processing:


Manage the RMA process, including receiving, processing, and tracking returned materials.

  

  

Other Duties:


Perform other related tasks as assigned from time to time by the manager and senior staff.

  

  

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE


A bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, International Trade, or a related field is required. Alternatively, relevant work experience in a related field may be considered in lieu of a degree. All candidates must possess a high school diploma or equivalent.


2\-3 years of experience in logistics, operations, manufacturing or a related field.


Relevant internship experience may be considered in lieu of full\-time work experience.

  

  

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES


Strong organizational and time\-management skills: Ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and meet deadlines.


Excellent communication skills (written and verbal): Ability to communicate effectively with internal teams, customers, and vendors.


Attention to detail and accuracy: Ability to ensure data accuracy and prevent errors in order processing and documentation.


Proficiency in Excel for reporting and data analysis.


Problem\-solving and analytical skills: Ability to identify and resolve issues related to orders, shipments, and customer inquiries.


Customer service orientation: Ability to provide excellent customer service and build positive relationships.

As a Client Success Representative, you'll lead sales efforts for AT\&T's wireless solutions. * Address client questions about AT\&T smartphones and data plans with clarity, patience, and genuine care.
* Showcase attractive AT\&T promotions designed to maximize value on smartphones and data plans and create sales momentum.
* Guide clients smoothly and confidently through the process of selecting AT\&T’s smartphones and data plans.

* Excellent communication skills that create trust and engagement with clients.
* Comfort discussing devices, data plans, and service options with confidence.

* High resilience and a positive outlook when working toward sales and success goals.
* Results\-driven mindset focused on achieving individual and team performance targets.

**Social Media \& Content Coordinator**

**Company:** Snapp Stats  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time Contract, with potential to convert to permanent full\-time  
**Compensation:** $55,000–$60,000 annualized, depending on experience  
**Location:** Remote / San Francisco preferred

**About Snapp**

Snapp is building AI for sports fans.

Our product helps fans follow their teams, manage fantasy leagues, track bets, get real\-time scores and analysis, and ask questions about sports through AI.

We're looking for a **Social Media \& Content Coordinator** who lives and breathes sports, social media, and internet culture.

This is a hands\-on, early\-career role supporting Snapp's social and content efforts across **organic social, paid social creative, and UGC creators**.

You won't be expected to own Snapp's entire social strategy. You'll work closely with our team to help execute it: creating and sourcing content, engaging with sports fans, developing creative for social ads, finding great UGC creators, and helping us produce more content, faster.

If you've grown a social following of your own, even better.

**What You'll Do**

**Support Organic Social**

You'll help keep Snapp active, relevant, and engaged across X, Instagram, TikTok, and other social platforms. You'll:

* Help create and publish daily organic content
* Monitor sports news, fantasy, betting, and trending conversations for content opportunities
* Help create memes, graphics, clips, short\-form videos, and social\-native posts
* Engage with fans through replies, comments, and quote posts
* Identify conversations and trending moments Snapp should participate in
* Help source interesting sports content, memes, clips, and ideas for the team
* Turn Snapp product features, sports data, and insights into engaging social content
* Assist with maintaining our content calendar and posting cadence

A big part of this role is understanding **what people actually want to engage with**, not just filling a content calendar.

**Help With Paid Social Creative**

You'll work alongside our growth team to help develop and source creative for Meta, TikTok, and other paid channels. You'll:

* Identify organic content and concepts that could translate into strong ads
* Brainstorm hooks, creative concepts, and new angles
* Source videos, clips, screenshots, and other creative assets
* Help create variations of winning ads and concepts
* Organize our paid creative library and pipeline
* Monitor competitor ads and emerging creative trends
* Help identify why certain creative is performing
* Turn winning ideas into additional creative variations

You don't need to be an experienced media buyer. We're looking for someone who understands **content and creative** and is excited to learn how that translates into paid growth.

**Find \& Curate UGC Creators**

A major part of this role will be helping us build and manage a network of creators who can produce content for Snapp. You'll:

* Find sports, fantasy, betting, and lifestyle creators who fit the Snapp brand
* Reach out to potential UGC creators
* Evaluate creators based on content quality, personality, and audience fit
* Maintain and organize our creator pipeline
* Help develop creator briefs, concepts, and talking points
* Coordinate creator deliverables and deadlines
* Review incoming UGC and provide feedback
* Identify our best\-performing creators and content
* Find creators we should work with repeatedly
* Help develop creators into longer\-term Snapp ambassadors
* Stay on top of emerging creators before everyone else finds them

We're looking for someone with a good eye for **potential**, not just someone who looks at follower counts.

**Drive Engagement**

We want Snapp to feel like part of the sports conversation, not a brand talking at people. You'll help:

* Reply to sports fans, creators, teams, and other accounts
* Jump into relevant conversations in real time
* Write replies that are funny, useful, or interesting
* Build relationships with sports and creator accounts
* Identify opportunities to turn engagement into new followers and users
* Experiment with different ways to increase comments, shares, and conversation

You should understand that sometimes **a great reply can be more valuable than the original post.**

**What We're Looking For**

We're looking for someone who:

* Is genuinely interested in sports
* Has a strong understanding of social media and internet culture
* Understands how sports fans communicate online
* Has strong instincts around what content will get attention
* Writes great captions, hooks, replies, and short\-form copy
* Is comfortable engaging with people online
* Understands TikTok, Instagram, X, and short\-form video
* Can identify good creators and content quickly
* Is highly organized and able to manage multiple projects at once
* Is comfortable moving quickly and testing lots of ideas
* Is willing to create, edit, source, organize, and execute
* Is interested in learning both organic and paid social

You do **not** need years of professional social media experience.

We're much more interested in whether you understand the internet and know how to create content people actually want to consume.

**Huge Plus If You Have**

* Grown your own social media following
* Built a sports, fantasy, betting, meme, or fan account
* Grown an account to 10K\+ followers
* Created TikToks, Reels, Shorts, or posts that generated significant organic reach

* Built or helped manage an online community

If you've built an audience yourself, **show us.**

We care more about seeing what you've actually created than seeing a perfectly formatted résumé.

new_jobs.title: Enterprise Implementation Specialist, Americas
new_jobs.description:
### **About Ahrefs**



Ahrefs is an all\-in\-one marketing intelligence platform used by marketers, businesses and agencies around the world. Our tools help people understand search demand, analyse competitors, improve website performance and research content opportunities, backed by 15 years of web crawling data and increasingly powered by AI.



We're bootstrapped and profitable, and we have been for 15 years. There are no investors and no board, which means no outside timeline on our decisions. We're multinational, with offices in Palo Alto, Cambridge (MA), Singapore and Tokyo, and our culture is fast\-moving, low\-ego, and built on smart decisions and ownership.


### **The role**



We're looking for an Enterprise Implementation Specialist to own the technical support and implementation after an enterprise customer signs.



That's the whole job, and it's a big one. You'll take a brand\-new Ahrefs Enterprise account from contract to fully live: setting up the account, migrating their keyword sets across from whatever they were using before, and running the onboarding training. When something breaks or someone gets stuck, you're who they reach. When renewal comes around, the reason they say yes is largely the work you did in the first ninety days.



You'll work directly alongside our Account Managers. They own the account strategy and the commercial relationship: where the customer is heading and what they need. You own making it real. It's a genuine partnership, and it only works if both halves are strong.



This role is based out of one of our offices, Palo Alto (CA) or Cambridge (MA). You can be based in whichever you have the legal right to work in, but this is an on\-site role. You'll serve customers across the Americas.


### **What you'll do**


* Run hands\-on account setup for new enterprise customers, configuring projects, workspaces, permissions and integrations to match how each customer actually works.
* Own keyword migrations end to end: audit what they have, map it across, move it, validate it, and make sure nothing quietly went missing.
* Deliver onboarding training to customer teams, from the SEO practitioners to marketing managers.
* Be the technical escalation point for your accounts: triage support requests, dig into the actual problem, resolve what you can, and drive what you can't to the right people internally.
* Turn what you learn into reusable assets (migration playbooks, training materials, documentation) so the tenth implementation is faster than the first.
* Feed real customer friction back to Product.

### **Must have**


* 3\-5 years in customer support, implementation, onboarding, technical account management, or a comparable hands\-on post\-sale role at a SaaS company.
* Direct experience taking enterprise customers live. You've owned a go\-live, not just supported one.
* Genuine comfort with data migration work: mapping, transforming, validating, and explaining to a customer why their 40,000 keywords came across as 39,847\.
* The ability to run a training session and have the attendees leave able to do the thing.
* Real technical range: APIs, integrations, CSVs, spreadsheets at scale, and the instinct to reproduce a bug before escalating it.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* The ability to figure things out independently.
* AI must be a part of your daily workflow.
* A "first do it, then do it right, then do it better" mentality. The tenth implementation should be faster or smoother than the first.

### **Nice to have**


* Working knowledge of SEO: keyword research, rank tracking, site audits, backlinks. You don't need to be a practitioner, but you should know what a customer means when they say their crawl budget is a problem.
* Hands\-on time with Ahrefs, or with a competing enterprise SEO platform.
* Experience with enterprise onboarding at scale.
* Experience working next to an account management or CS function.

### **What success looks like**


**In 6 months:** you'll be running enterprise implementations independently, start to finish. Account Managers will be routing technical questions to you by default rather than escalating them upward.


**In 1 year:** you'll be the person who knows more about how enterprise customers deploy Ahrefs at scale than anyone else in the company. You'll have a clear process and a view of where implementation should be automated rather than repeated.



Ahrefs does not engage with agencies or third\-party recruitment providers for the roles we hire for. If we need help, we'll let you know.


**Location:** Palo Alto (CA) or Cambridge (MA). On\-site.


Ahrefs does not engage with agencies or third party recruitment solutions for the roles we hire for. If at any point we need help, we'll let you know!

The Investment Office is responsible for the Library's $2\.0 billion endowment investment program. **Description:**  

  

**Position Summary:** The Division of Early Childhood Education (DECE) supports the operational and programmatic functions of early childhood education programs for New York City children in elementary schools, Pre\-K Centers and New York City Public Schools (NYCPS) contracted settings included in Community Based Organizations (CBO) and through Family Childcare (FCC) programs. DECE provides families with access to high quality, inclusive early childhood programs for children birth to five, in rich diverse settings, supporting children’s growth and development. Working together with families and programs, DECE ensures that children are engaged, nurtured and supported.
The Policy Development Coordinator will support the Manager and Director of Policy Development in advancing critical policy initiatives for DECE. The Coordinator will play a key role in supporting research, implementation and monitoring of policy priorities that ensure alignment with NYCPS, City and State requirements. This role will assist in data collection and analysis, development of policy materials and coordination of cross functional efforts that support the integration of early childhood programs into the broader Birth–12th grade education system. Performs related work.


**Reports to:** Manager of Policy Development, DECE  

**Direct Reports:** N/A  

**Key Relationships:** Division of Early Childhood Education central and field teams; relevant Central NYCPS teams; NYCPS field offices and staff; New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH); NYC Administration for Children’s Services (ACS); New York State Office of Children and Family Services (OCFS); other City, State and Federal agencies; and program leaders in district schools, community based early childhood centers and Family Child Care Networks.  

**Responsibilities**
* Assist in the development, implementation and monitoring of policy initiatives that support DECE priorities and early childhood program quality.
* Support the design and administration of surveys, data collection tools and feedback mechanisms to inform policy development.
* Conduct research and gather information on local, State, and Federal policies, regulations and legislation impacting early childhood education.
* Assist in drafting policy briefs, guidance documents, presentations and communications for internal and external audiences.
* Support the development of policies related to enrollment, staffing, program budgets, compliance and other key early childhood topics.
* Coordinate with internal and external partners to support alignment of DECE policy with broader NYCPS and regulatory requirements.
* Assist in monitoring compliance with City, State and Federal regulations across early childhood programs.
* Analyze data and support the identification of trends, challenges, and opportunities to improve policy implementation.
* Support the preparation of reports, presentations and materials for DECE leadership and stakeholders.
* Assist in planning and coordinating meetings, trainings, and professional development sessions related to policy implementation.
* Maintain organized documentation and track progress toward policy related milestones and deliverables.
* Provide general project management support to ensure timely advancement of policy initiatives.

**Qualification Requirements:**  

**Minimum**  

* A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two (2\) years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties described above; or


* High school graduation or equivalent and six (6\) years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties as described above; or


* Education and/or experience which is equivalent to “1” or “2” above. However, all candidates must have at least one (1\) year of experience as described in “1” above.


*Plus*


In addition to meeting the minimum requirements, individuals must have two additional years of relevant work experience.

  

**Preferred**
* Experience supporting policy development, research, or program implementation in education or public sector settings.
* Knowledge of NYCPS policy and procedures and the ability to interpret and apply policies effectively, particularly within early childhood education.
* Familiarity with DOHMH Article 43 and 47 regulations, OCFS Child Care regulations, and Head Start Program Performance Standards (HSPPS).
* Strong research and analytical skills, including experience working with data to inform decision making.
* Excellent written and spoken communication skills.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Ability to organize and present information clearly and concisely to a variety of audiences.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
* High attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate documentation.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 applications.

**Salary**: $72,114 \- $80,000

  

(Internal candidates who are selected for this position and who currently hold comparable or less senior positions within the DOE will not earn less than their current salary.)

  

**Please include a resume and cover letter with your application.**

Clinical Research Coordinator I will oversee multiple clinical trials, investigator\-initiated studies, and quality improvement projects within the department of Neurology, serving as a point person for patients, their family members and the clinical study team. **Under general supervision duties will include:**  

* Directing seamless flow of daily trial\-related activities, recruitment and clinical assessments of the study subjects
* Directing strict adherence to the study protocols, as well as sponsor, FDA and other regulatory authority requirements.
* Designs and implements workflows for clinical trial, including reminders/updates to the clinical team
* Coordinating team members to complete both clinical and non\-clinical assessments per protocol. This includes developing workflow for patient care such as assigning secretaries to schedule patients, developing workflow with ancillary departments (such as radiology, advanced imaging, pathology, pharmacy), and assigning appropriate clinical team members such as doctors to complete clinical tasks such as reviewing adverse events versus assigning non\-clinical team members to complete non clinical tasks such as administering questionnaires to a patient.
* Executing IRB submissions (event reporting, study status change etc.)
* Executing patient billing in multiple databases including the patient's electronic medical record.
* Developing action plans for ensuring all study tasks are completed as required per the protocol and developing subsequent corrective action plans if any errors are made.

The Clinical Research Coordinator I will be trained to be highly specialized in clinical trials assigned to them. The Clinical Research Coordinator I is expected to be able to manage clinical trial projects independently after sufficient training is completed
  

  

**Essential Functions*** Escalates issues related to clinical trial conduct to PI and senior research staff.
* Assigns training to the PI and other research team members for protocol amendments, and any other study required training.
* Screens and consents patients and ensures the scheduling and completion of assessments for ongoing study visits as dictated by the protocol
* Collects required data and imaging and ensures data entry into EDCs/Databases and image upload to imaging portals.
* Develops and executes multifaceted recruitment strategies by blending creative patient outreach with technical workflow integration and cross\-departmental partnerships to optimize subject identification and enrollment.
* Oversees the quality of data provided to sponsor, escalates quality issues to the site manager.
* Maintains accurate records of study participants while safeguarding the confidentiality of subjects, as necessary.
* Maintains essential documents per FDA, Regulatory bodies, and sponsor requirements in the Regulatory Binder. This includes preparation of essential documents for the assigned clinical study
* Provides ready access to patient binders and regulatory binders to the PI, Sponsor and/or Regulatory Authorities for assigned clinical trials.
* Coordinates and carries out monitoring visits and audits for assigned clinical trial.
* Collaborates with appropriate institutional review board to ensure approval of the clinical trial (renewal), approval of study documents (renewal, modification, notification) and personnel.
* Assists management with collection of updated essential documents and certifications for site personnel and sends these to sponsor as requested.
* Participates in Site Initiation Visit.
* Processes, packages, stores and ships clinical specimens as required by the protocol.
* Responsible for device accountability, ordering and storage of investigational products and/or lab kits.
Performs other duties as assigned dependent on the nature of the clinical trial.  
* 

  

**Qualifications**

* BS Required
* OHS Annual Assessment Required
* OHS Fit Test Required
* CITI Good Clinical Practice Certification, CITI Research with Biomedical Drugs and Devices Certification, CITI Dangerous Goods and Biospecimen Handling Certification.
  

Experience in clinical research ,clinical trials and/or any medical related profession. Preferred

new_jobs.description:
**Are you looking to Optimize your life? Start your exciting path to a rewarding career today!**

  

We are Optimum, a leader in the fast\-paced world of connectivity, and we're seeking driven and enthusiastic professionals to join our team, empower lives, fuel businesses, and drive innovation. Connectivity is now longer a luxury, but a necessity. A career at Optimum means you'll be enabling progress and enhancing lives by providing reliable, high\-speed connectivity solutions that keep the world connected. Our successes, now and in the future, are powered by our amazing product, a commitment to our people and culture, and the connections we make in our communities.

  

If you are resourceful, collaborative, and passionate about delivering consistent excellence, Optimum is for you!


**Job Summary**
---------------



As a Community Account Manager, you will be assigned a portfolio of muti\-dwelling unit properties. The primary responsibility as CAM, is to grow and maintain market share by selling new movers, win\-back customers, and upgrade existing customers to maximize monthly recurring revenue. Additionally, our CAM, will develop and manage the onsite relationship with the leasing staff, to ensure we are maximizing the terms of our marketing agreement, driving growth through educating staff and residents about the value of our products and reliability of our service, while positioning Optimum favorably against competitors and for contract renewals. In this role, you will be assigned new properties ensuring we maximize MDU new build customer penetration by working with onsite sales personnel and internal field operations to be “first to the door”.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Consistent achievement of monthly sales, revenue quotas and key performance indicators.
* Coordinate marketing events and cultivate relationships with sales, leasing staff and HOA's representing our brand, products while providing service excellence.
* Conduct site and virtual visits with property staff, updating and replenishing sales collateral, and educating leasing staff about new and existing product offers and the value of the optimum brand.
* Schedule quarterly/semi\-annual reviews with property staff to “walk” the property, understand business trends and share property performance against established targets.
* Act as a liaison between property management and our internal Technical Operations, Construction Department and Sales Support to address service issues that impacts our ability to deliver on\-time and exceptional service.
* Timely tracking and reporting of all sales, events, visits, and property escalations.
* Act as a point of contact with Bulk Property management staff, coordinating new customer onboarding and de\-bulk events.
* All other duties assigned by your supervisor.
**Qualifications**
------------------


* 5\+ years related experience.
* Ability to travel up to 75%
* Strong communication skills are a must.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Office Suite programs is required.
* Business Development experience with emphasis on new customer acquisition and relationship management.
* Must be self\-motivated and able to work independently.
* Computer skills, including Windows\-based applications, and the ability to work within Salesforce and sales order entry and CRM platforms.
* Strong people and relationship management skills.
* Must possess and maintain a valid driver’s license in good standing within the state of current residence.


At Optimum, every action and interaction we take part in, is driven by our three Guiding Principles: Do What’s Right, Drive One Optimum, and Make It Happen. These aren’t just words, they help us build trust, create real community, and embrace new ways of thinking. Our employees are empowered to do the right thing for our customers and co\-workers and to recognize and reward these behaviors when we see them. It’s all part of the bigger picture of “Be The Difference” where each employee knows they have the power to enact real change, share new ideas, and understand that learning never stops.

  

If you have the drive to succeed and are ready to embark on a thrilling career, seize this opportunity today, and join our winning team. Together, we'll shape the future of connectivity.

We're solving a huge challenge for product managers and developers \- understanding the user experience. LogRocket is the first system that gives these teams complete visibility into their customer's experience using their web apps \- through pixel\-perfect replays of user sessions and clear insight into logs, errors, and network activity. We've already attracted an elite roster of over 3,000 customers including ClassPass, Capital One, Cisco, and Rippling, just to name a few. Our focus is on building software with care and craftsmanship and our engineering blog posts offer a taste of that.

Backed by top investors such as Matrix Partners, Battery Ventures, and Delta\-V Capital, we've raised $55M in funding, and we're eager to bring talented people onboard to support our growth. We're on a mission to improve society's experience with software and that's where you come in.
### **Qualifications**

* 1\-2\+ years experience in product management and/or data analytics role
* Experience with customer support, technical customer support, or solution engineering desired
* Experience in building and/or supporting customer retention, churn, and upsells
* Ability to work with key champions, build relationships and uncover potential areas of expansion
* Self\-learner and self\-starter, able to become a product expert and customer advocate
* Strong organizational skills and detail\-oriented skills needed
* Excellent written and verbal skills (you will be leading calls with Executives and other key stakeholders)
* Demonstrated ability to communicate both technical and business concepts
* Drive long\-term customer adoption through scalable onboarding with multiple departments and use cases
* Proven track record of managing successful cross\-functional programs that drive customer success
* Ability to work cross\-departmentally with internal teams such as sales, product, and support
* Technology industry experience preferred
* Love for start\-ups is a must!

### **Responsibilities**

* Customer Success Managers own the relationship, adoption and success for a book of customers, from onboarding through to renewal
* Consult with customers to understand their business, product, and application goals and confirm value delivery/ROI
* You’ll help define strategy to deliver maximum value through the LogRocket platform and partnership
* You’ll be responsible for successfully onboarding new customers focused on their time to value for their priorities, projects and use cases
* The CSM is responsible for being multi\-threaded across teams and executives, executed through regular emails, informal weekly calls, monthly health\-checks, QBRs \& Executive Business Reviews
* The CSM proactively monitors and takes action to ensure broad team feature usage, positive health scores, and demonstrated value, to achieve high retention rates, and strong customer revenue growth
* CSMs keep account plans to white\-space and uncover upsell opportunities in their accounts. For assigned customers, CSM also collaborate with LogRocket Account Managers to extend the use of LogRocket to new teams and applications to increase ARR.
* CSMs are the bridge and liaison between customer, product and support to ensure customer tickets and feature requests are managed, communicated, and closed out appropriately
* You’ll be responsible for proactively managing retention and upsell pipeline and forecasts to exceed quarterly goals, keeping internal CRM platforms up to date

### **Benefits \& Perks**

* Extensive health, dental, vision benefits, 401k and commuter benefits
* Open vacation policy \- we all work hard and take time for ourselves when we need it, no strings attached
* Three months of fully\-paid parental leave to any employee welcoming a child into their home
* 401k and commuter benefits
* Generous stock options \- we all get to own a piece of what we’re building
* Regular team outings and activities (from boat rides to paintball, we’ll try anything!)
* Flexible working hours and location
* Monthly employee gifts
* For those in the office, catered lunches throughout the week and a fully stocked kitchen with all your favorite snacks (healthy \& non\-healthy)

This range is intended to provide a guideline for our typical compensation and may be modified based on location or experience of our finalist candidate. Ranges are broad based on the fact that we hire at various levels of experience for these positions.
Even if you don’t meet all of the listed requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We believe learning is a vital component of success in any role here at LogRocket, and we’re happy to chat with folks from non\-traditional backgrounds for our open roles.

LogRocket is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

LogRocket will consider sponsoring visas for applicants in the US that need work authorization.
